title: 646. The Fall of the Incas: Death to the Emperor (Part 3)

sentences.en: Atahualpa speaks.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕开口了。

sentences.en: Atahualpa needs.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕有需求。

sentences.en: Atahualpa commands.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕下令了。

sentences.en: Bring him gold.
sentences.zh: 给他带来黄金。

sentences.en: From the palaces, from the temples, from all buildings in the great places.
sentences.zh: 从宫殿里，从神庙里，从伟大之地的所有建筑中。

sentences.en: From walls of pleasure and roofs of omen.
sentences.zh: 从享乐的墙壁和预兆的屋顶下。

sentences.en: From floors of feasting and ceilings of death.
sentences.zh: 从宴饮的地板和死亡的穹顶上。

sentences.en: Bring him the gold of Quito and Pachamacacacac.
sentences.zh: 给他带来基多和帕查卡马克的黄金。

sentences.en: Bring him the gold of Cusco and Coricancha.
sentences.zh: 给他带来库斯科和科里坎查的黄金。

sentences.en: Bring him the gold of Vilcanota.
sentences.zh: 给他带来维尔卡诺塔的黄金。

sentences.en: Bring him the gold of
sentences.zh: 给他带来……的黄金。

sentences.en: Colai, of Amareus and Arequipa.
sentences.zh: 科莱、阿马雷乌斯和阿雷基帕的黄金。

sentences.en: Bring him the gold of the Chimu.
sentences.zh: 给他带来奇穆人的黄金。

sentences.en: Put up a mountain of gold and free your son from his prison of clouds.
sentences.zh: 堆起一座金山，让你儿子从云端的囚笼中重获自由。

sentences.en: So that was Christopher Plummer playing Atahualpa,
sentences.zh: 刚才那是克里斯托弗·普卢默饰演的阿塔瓦尔帕，

sentences.en: Emperor of the Incas in Peter Schaffer's play, The Royal Hunt of the Sun, which we've been hearing a lot of in this series.
sentences.zh: 也就是彼得·谢弗的剧作《太阳的皇家狩猎》中的印加皇帝，我们在本系列节目中经常提到这部作品。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa in that scene is summoning his people to one of the most
sentences.zh: 在那一幕中，阿塔瓦尔帕正在召集他的子民，去完成世界历史上最

sentences.en: memorable endeavors in the whole of world history.
sentences.zh: 令人难忘的壮举之一。

sentences.en: And it's the kind of scene that maybe as a child, you have a book of world history and you read about it and you think, wow, that's mad.
sentences.zh: 这种场景，或许你小时候在世界历史书上读到过，你会想，哇，这太疯狂了。

sentences.en: That couldn't possibly have happened.
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能发生呢？

sentences.en: And that is exactly what happened to me.
sentences.zh: 而这正是发生在我身上的事。

sentences.en: I had a book of world history and there was Atahualpa with Francisco Pizarro in a kind of very cool hat and a beard.
sentences.zh: 我有一本世界历史书，上面画着阿塔瓦尔帕和弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗，皮萨罗戴着一顶很酷的帽子，留着胡子。

sentences.en: They were chatting away and they're in this room and there's this kind of piles of gold mounting up.
sentences.zh: 他们正在聊天，身处一个房间里，周围堆满了金子。

sentences.en: And on the room, there is a white line that's been drawn around it.
sentences.zh: 房间的墙上画着一条白线。

sentences.en: And you realize that Atahualpa has to get enough gold to reach that white line.
sentences.zh: 你意识到阿塔瓦尔帕必须筹集到足够的黄金，填满到那条白线的高度。

sentences.en: And Dominic, I have never forgotten it because the jeopardy is immense, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，我从未忘记这一幕，因为那种危机感太强烈了，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If he doesn't get enough gold to reach that white line, he's going to die.
sentences.zh: 如果他筹集不到足够的黄金填满那条白线，他就会死。

sentences.en: If he does get enough gold to reach that white line, well, what then?
sentences.zh: 如果他真的筹集到了足够的黄金填满那条白线，那么，接下来会怎样呢？

sentences.en: We will find out in today's episode, won't we?
sentences.zh: 我们会在今天的节目中找到答案，对吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, you're not wrong.
sentences.zh: 没错，你说得对。

sentences.en: This is exactly it.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: I had this encyclopedia of world history as a child, maybe the same one that you did.
sentences.zh: 我小时候也有一本世界历史百科全书，可能和你的是同一本。

sentences.en: Is it the R.J.
sentences.zh: 是R.J.

sentences.en: Unstead book of world history?
sentences.zh: 昂斯特德写的那本世界历史书吗？

sentences.en: It probably was, actually.
sentences.zh: 其实很可能就是那本。

sentences.en: But he wrote all history books in the 1970s, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 但他写了20世纪70年代所有的历史书，不是吗？

sentences.en: In the 1960s and 70s.
sentences.zh: 是在60年代和70年代。

sentences.en: So yeah, it's a brilliant book.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，那是一本很棒的书。

sentences.en: And there was this picture and there's this bloke gesturing at the wall.
sentences.zh: 书里有张图，那个人正指着墙壁。

sentences.en: And they're filling it with kind of golden llamas and stuff like piling up.
sentences.zh: 他们正在往房间里堆放金羊驼之类的东西，越堆越高。

sentences.en: And if he fills the room, the Spanish will let him go.
sentences.zh: 如果他填满了这个房间，西班牙人就会放他走。

sentences.en: This is in Cajamarca where he's been taken prisoner.
sentences.zh: 这是在卡哈马卡，他被俘虏的地方。

sentences.en: And if he doesn't fill the room, they will burn him or garrot him.
sentences.zh: 如果他填不满这个房间，他们就会烧死他或用绞刑处死他。

sentences.en: And basically, you can't wait to find out what happens next.
sentences.zh: 基本上，你迫不及待地想知道接下来会发生什么。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: This really happened.
sentences.zh: 这一切真的发生了。

sentences.en: And this is the story we're telling in today's episode.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们今天这期节目要讲的故事。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: So let's remind ourselves where we got to in the story of the fall of the Incas.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们回顾一下印加帝国覆灭史讲到了哪里。

sentences.en: So people will remember, Francisco Pizarro and his fellow conquistadors had arrived in Cajamarca in November 1533.
sentences.zh: 大家应该还记得，弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗和他的征服者同伴们于1533年11月抵达了卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: And they'd holed up waiting for this bloke Atahualpa, the emperor of the Incas, who's been fighting a civil war against his brother Huascar.
sentences.zh: 他们躲在那里，等待着那个叫阿塔瓦尔帕的印加皇帝，他当时正与兄弟瓦斯卡尔进行内战。

sentences.en: And Huascar is in a cage, isn't he, at this point, being brought from Cusco to where Atahualpa is.
sentences.zh: 而瓦斯卡尔当时被关在笼子里，正从库斯科被押往阿塔瓦尔帕所在的地方，对吧？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Huascar has been taken prisoner.
sentences.zh: 瓦斯卡尔已经被俘虏了。

sentences.en: So Atahualpa had won the civil war, effectively.
sentences.zh: 所以阿塔瓦尔帕实际上已经赢得了内战。

sentences.en: Now, Atahualpa made this grand entrance to the town square, which we described last time.
sentences.zh: 现在，阿塔瓦尔帕在城镇广场上进行了那次盛大的入场，我们上次描述过。

sentences.en: There's this confrontation with the Dominican friar Bicente de Valverde.
sentences.zh: 他与多米尼加修士比森特·德·瓦尔韦德发生了对峙。

sentences.en: And then the Spanish charged into the square and they took him prisoner and they killed all his men.
sentences.zh: 然后西班牙人冲进广场，俘虏了他，并杀死了他所有的手下。

sentences.en: And we ended with this bonkers scene where he's taken in, dressed in new clothes to have dinner with Pizarro.
sentences.zh: 我们结束于那个疯狂的场景：他被带进去，换上新衣服，与皮萨罗共进晚餐。

sentences.en: And then to curl up with him for the night.
sentences.zh: 然后还要和他蜷缩在一起过夜。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And then spend the night with him.
sentences.zh: 然后和他共度一晚。

sentences.en: And you suggested that Pizarro was a snorer, which would just make things even worse, wouldn't it?
sentences.zh: 你暗示皮萨罗会打呼噜，这只会让情况变得更糟，不是吗？

sentences.en: He's definitely a snorer.
sentences.zh: 他绝对会打呼噜。

sentences.en: Pizarro's in his fifties.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗五十多岁了。

sentences.en: He's kind of tall.
sentences.zh: 他个子挺高。

sentences.en: He's broad.
sentences.zh: 他很宽阔。

sentences.en: He's burly.
sentences.zh: 他很魁梧。

sentences.en: I mean, that's a snorer.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那肯定会打呼噜。

sentences.en: Definitely.
sentences.zh: 肯定的。

sentences.en: Well, I think, I mean, that description applies to me as well.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想，那个描述也适用于我。

sentences.en: I don't think I'm a snorer.
sentences.zh: 我不觉得我会打呼噜。

sentences.en: You're not burly.
sentences.zh: 你又不魁梧。

sentences.en: I mean, no one would call you burly in a million years.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，没人会说你魁梧，哪怕过一百万年也不会。

sentences.en: People watching on YouTube will be able to see that.
sentences.zh: 在YouTube上看节目的观众都能看出来。

sentences.en: See how burly Tom is.
sentences.zh: 看看汤姆有多魁梧。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So he ended with nightfalling, the carrion crows feasting on the bodies of the dead and so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 所以我们结束于夜幕降临，食腐乌鸦在尸体上大快朵颐等等场景。

sentences.en: And let's pick up straight away on the morning of the
sentences.zh: 让我们直接从1533年11月17日的早晨开始讲起。

sentences.en: 17th of November, 1533.
Atahualpa wakes and he's in a state of shock.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕醒来时处于震惊状态。

sentences.en: Clearly Pizarro has got up first without disturbing him because he's taken in...
sentences.zh: 显然皮萨罗先起床了，没有打扰他，因为他被带去……

sentences.en: Cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 喝杯茶。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: To see Pizarro and the other Spanish captains.
sentences.zh: 去见皮萨罗和其他西班牙船长。

sentences.en: We found him full of fear thinking that we were going to kill him.
sentences.zh: 我们发现他充满了恐惧，以为我们要杀了他。

sentences.en: Well, duh.
sentences.zh: 废话。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And Pizarro says to Atahualpa this amazing thing.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗对阿塔瓦尔帕说了这番惊人的话。

sentences.en: He says, don't be sorrowful.
sentences.zh: 他说，不要悲伤。

sentences.en: He says, we Christians, we've gone to many countries.
sentences.zh: 他说，我们基督徒去过许多国家。

sentences.en: We've met many mighty rulers and one way or another, we've made them all our friends and vassals.
sentences.zh: 我们见过许多强大的统治者，无论如何，我们都让他们成为了我们的朋友和附庸。

sentences.en: So you shouldn't be shocked that we've captured you.
sentences.zh: 所以你不应该因为我们俘虏了你而感到震惊。

sentences.en: I don't know whether that's any consolation.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这算不算安慰。

sentences.en: Well, I suppose it kind of is because it suggests they're not going to kill him.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想这算是一种安慰，因为它暗示他们不会杀他。

sentences.en: Well, hold on.
sentences.zh: 等等。

sentences.en: If Atahualpa had said, well, who's the most famous person you've treated in this manner?
sentences.zh: 如果阿塔瓦尔帕问，那么你们这样对待过最出名的人是谁？

sentences.en: And they'd say, well, Mons is human.
sentences.zh: 他们会说，嗯，是蒙特祖马。

sentences.en: At that point, his face might fall a little when he discovered the fate of the emperor of the Aztecs.
sentences.zh: 到那时，当他发现阿兹特克皇帝的命运时，他的脸色可能会变得很难看。

sentences.en: Fair point.
sentences.zh: 有道理。

sentences.en: So Atahualpa says, are you going to kill me?
sentences.zh: 所以阿塔瓦尔帕问，你们要杀我吗？

sentences.en: And Pizarro says, no, no, no, we're Christians.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗说，不，不，不，我们是基督徒。

sentences.en: So that means we don't kill people in cold blood.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们不会冷血地杀人。

sentences.en: We will see in this episode how true that is.
sentences.zh: 我们将在本集中看到这句话有多真实。

sentences.en: And then I think disastrously for the Incas generally, Atahualpa sends a message to his army and he says, do not flee, do not resiSt. Wait for my orders.
sentences.zh: 然后我认为对印加人来说极其灾难性的是，阿塔瓦尔帕给他的军队传了话，他说，不要逃跑，不要反抗。等待我的命令。

sentences.en: I'm not dead.
sentences.zh: 我没死。

sentences.en: I'm in the power of the Christians.
sentences.zh: 我落在了基督徒手里。

sentences.en: Later that morning, Pizarro's lieutenant, Hernando de Soto, who's described as swashbuckling or dashing.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，皮萨罗的副手埃尔南多·德·索托，他被描述为剑客或风度翩翩的人。

sentences.en: Posh.
sentences.zh: 时髦。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he ends up in Arkansas or thereabouts.
sentences.zh: 他最后去了阿肯色州或附近。

sentences.en: Looking for the fountain of youth.
sentences.zh: 寻找青春之泉。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So Soto goes off to the camp of the Atahualpa army, which is about 70 or 80,000 strong, supposedly.
sentences.zh: 所以索托去了阿塔瓦尔帕军队的营地，据说那里有七八万人。

sentences.en: So they're outside the city.
sentences.zh: 他们就在城外。

sentences.en: They offer no resistance when Soto turns up.
sentences.zh: 当索托出现时，他们没有进行任何抵抗。

sentences.en: They don't interfere with him at all.
sentences.zh: 他们根本没有干涉他。

sentences.en: They just don't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他们只是不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: They're completely bewildered.
sentences.zh: 他们完全困惑了。

sentences.en: This has never happened before.
sentences.zh: 这种情况以前从未发生过。

sentences.en: These people who might as well have come from the moon have captured their emperor.
sentences.zh: 这些仿佛从月球上来的人俘虏了他们的皇帝。

sentences.en: They're just stunned.
sentences.zh: 他们完全惊呆了。

sentences.en: And actually following Atahualpa's orders, which are clearly been drafted by the Spanish or interfered with by the Spanish, we're
sentences.zh: 事实上，遵照阿塔瓦尔帕的命令——这些命令显然是由西班牙人起草或干预过的——我们被告知，他们中的许多人跪了下来，画了十字，基本上是对西班牙人表示顺从。

sentences.en: told that many of them dropped to their knees and made the sign of the cross, basically a sign of obedience to the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 所以这对皮萨罗来说太棒了，甚至更好。

sentences.en: So that's all great for Pizarro, even better.
sentences.zh: 当索托回到镇上时，索托说，我在营地里发现了很多东西，我把它们带回来了。

sentences.en: When Soto gets back to the town, Soto says, I found a lot of stuff in the camp and I brought it with me.
sentences.zh: 价值8万比索的黄金，7000马克的白银，还有14颗祖母绿。

sentences.en: 80,000 pesos worth of gold, 7,000 marks worth of silver, and 14 emeralds.
sentences.zh: 引用西班牙人的话，这些金银是怪异的雕像、大大小小的盘子、水罐、壶、盆、大酒杯以及其他各种物件。

sentences.en: To quote the Spanish, the gold and silver were in monstrous effigies, large and small dishes, pitchers, jugs, basins, large drinking vessels, and various other pieces.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕说这些都来自他的餐具。

sentences.en: Atahualpa said that this all came from his table service.
sentences.zh: 所以他们基本上带回了阿塔瓦尔帕的餐具。

sentences.en: So they've come back basically with Atahualpa's crockery.
sentences.zh: 我想此时西班牙人意识到，天哪，这些人除了审美价值外，根本不看重金银。

sentences.en: And it dawns on the Spanish, I think, at this point, my God, these people place no value on gold and silver other than aesthetic.
sentences.zh: 这东西很漂亮，所以这些人喜欢它，大人物也拥有它，但对他们来说它没有货币价值，因为印加人当然没有货币。

sentences.en: It's pretty, so these guys like it, and big wigs have it, but it has no monetary value to them because, of course, the Incas don't have money.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕看到西班牙人眼中闪烁着兴奋的光芒。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa sees the Spanish eyes glittering with excitement.
sentences.zh: 这给了他一个主意，这回到了你开头读的内容，汤姆。

sentences.en: And this gives him an idea, and this goes back to your reading at the beginning, Tom.
sentences.zh: 他说，嗯，如果你们这么喜欢这些东西，我的意思是，这是我的餐具。

sentences.en: He says, well, if you love this stuff so much, I mean, this is my crockery.
sentences.zh: 如果这对你们意义重大，我可以给你们更多。

sentences.en: I can give you much more of this if this means so much to you.
sentences.zh: 通过这些为西班牙人工作的翻译，他说，我可以给你们比你们梦想中还要多的金银。

sentences.en: And through these interpreters who are working for the Spanish, he says, I can give you more gold and silver than you could possibly dream of.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗问，到底有多少？

sentences.en: And Pizarro says, well, how much exactly?
sentences.zh: 然后是这个著名的时刻，阿塔瓦尔帕说。

sentences.en: And then this famous moment, Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 我可以把这个房间填满黄金，填到我能触及的高度。

sentences.en: I can fill this room with gold as high as I can reach.
sentences.zh: 他假装用手在墙上画了一条线。

sentences.en: And he sort of pretends to make a line on the wall with his hand.
sentences.zh: 西班牙文献记载，房间长22英尺，宽17英尺，要填满到其高度一半的一条白线处，即8英尺高。

sentences.en: And the Spanish sources say, the room measured 22 feet long by 17 feet wide, and it was to be filled to a white line halfway up its height, eight feet high.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，就是阿塔瓦尔帕能触及的高度。

sentences.en: So in other words, as high as Atahualpa can reach.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕说他会用金罐、壶、瓦片和其他物件填满它。

sentences.en: Atahualpa said he would fill it with gold jars, pots, tiles, and other pieces.
sentences.zh: 他还会用白银把房间填满两次，而且他会在两个月内完成这一切。

sentences.en: He would also fill the room twice over with silver, and he would do all this within two months.
sentences.zh: 所以这其中有一个时间限制。

sentences.en: So there's a time element to this.
sentences.zh: 这其中有一种危机感。

sentences.en: There's sort of elements of jeopardy.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗简直不敢相信。

sentences.en: Pizarro can't believe this.
sentences.zh: 他叫来了一名秘书，一个叫弗朗西斯科·德·赫雷斯的人，说，我要你把它写下来，做个记录。

sentences.en: And he calls in one of his secretaries, he's a guy called Francisco de Jerez, and says, I want you to write this down, make a record.

sentences.zh: 而且这正是南美雨林里会发生的那种事。

sentences.en: Yes, to the sound of the panpipes, surely.
sentences.zh: 没错，肯定伴随着排箫的声音。

sentences.en: So even Atahualpa's generals, because don't forget, there's been civil war.
sentences.zh: 所以即使是阿塔瓦尔帕的将军们——别忘了，之前刚打过内战——

sentences.en: Even his generals act as though nothing has changed.
sentences.zh: 即便他的将军们表现得好像什么都没变一样。

sentences.en: It's important for people to realise there are the various armies roaming around.
sentences.zh: 人们意识到周围有各种军队在游荡，这一点很重要。

sentences.en: So two of Atahualpa's key generals who will play a part in the next couple of episodes are in the south.
sentences.zh: 所以阿塔瓦尔帕的两名关键将军，也就是接下来几集里会登场的人物，现在都在南方。

sentences.en: There's a guy with the excellent name of Kis Kis, who has just captured
sentences.zh: 有一个名字很响亮的家伙叫基斯·基斯（Kis Kis），他刚刚占领了

sentences.en: Cusco.
sentences.zh: 库斯科。

sentences.en: And there's another commander, basically the commander in chief, the oldest of the commanders, who's called Chalcochima.
sentences.zh: 还有另一位指挥官，基本上是总司令，也是最年长的指挥官，名叫查尔科奇马（Chalcochima）。

sentences.en: And Chalcochima is midway between Cusco and Cajamarca.
sentences.zh: 查尔科奇马正处于库斯科和卡哈马卡之间。

sentences.en: And both of these guys have about, I don't know, 40,000 men or something.
sentences.zh: 这两个家伙手下大概都有，我不知道，四万人左右吧。

sentences.en: Now there's a third general who we don't need to worry about right now, called Ruminyawi, who is much further north.
sentences.zh: 现在还有第三位将军，我们暂时不用担心他，叫鲁米尼亚维（Ruminyawi），他在更北边。

sentences.en: He's in Quito in the kind of home base of the Atahualpa side of the civil war divide.
sentences.zh: 他在基多，算是内战中阿塔瓦尔帕阵营的大本营。

sentences.en: Atahualpa says to these three generals, stay where you are, don't interfere with the ransom, wait for it to be collected.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕对这三位将军说，待在原地，不要干涉赎金的事，等赎金收齐。

sentences.en: The foreigners will go once the ransom is paid, and we can get on with the business of finishing off the war, killing our enemies and cementing control of the empire.
sentences.zh: 外国人拿到赎金就会走，我们就能继续完成战争，杀掉敌人，巩固对帝国的控制。

sentences.en: The question, I suppose, is as would his generals have tried to rescue him anyway?
sentences.zh: 我想问题在于，他的将军们本来会试图营救他吗？

sentences.en: And I would guess probably not, because everybody is so disorientated and baffled.
sentences.zh: 我猜大概不会，因为每个人都感到如此迷茫和困惑。

sentences.en: In his brilliant book, The Conquest of the Incas,
sentences.zh: 约翰·赫明（John Hemming）在他那本出色的《印加征服史》中，

sentences.en: John Hemming makes the excellent point that basically, in most places, the Europeans conquered.
sentences.zh: 提出了一个极好的观点，即基本上在大多数地方，欧洲人都征服了当地。

sentences.en: Europeans had arrived multiple times before they actually turned up for good.
sentences.zh: 欧洲人在真正长期驻扎之前，已经多次抵达过那里。

sentences.en: You know, missionaries had come, traders, envoys.
sentences.zh: 你知道，传教士、商人和使节都曾来过。

sentences.en: What's very unusual about the conquest of Peru is basically the Spanish to do it all in one go.
sentences.zh: 秘鲁征服战非常不同寻常的一点是，西班牙人基本上是一口气完成的。

sentences.en: So these generals have literally never seen a European, they've never heard of a European, until they hear some mad guys with beards have turned up and captured the emperor.
sentences.zh: 所以这些将军们真的从未见过欧洲人，甚至没听说过，直到他们听说一群留着胡子的疯子出现了，还俘虏了皇帝。

sentences.en: They didn't even know Europe existed.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至不知道欧洲的存在。

sentences.en: But what do you think they find more disorientating?
sentences.zh: 但你觉得他们觉得什么更让人困惑？

sentences.en: The fact that Europeans have turned up with beards and stuff, or the fact that they have dared to seize the emperor and keep him as a hostage?
sentences.zh: 是欧洲人留着胡子之类的出现，还是他们竟然敢扣押皇帝并将其作为人质？

sentences.en: Because in a sense, that must be the thing that's really destabilizing, because there's nothing in their history or their ideology or
sentences.zh: 因为从某种意义上说，那一定是真正让人动摇的事情，因为在他们的历史、意识形态或

sentences.en: their experience that would enable them to know what to do in such a scenario.
sentences.zh: 经验中，没有任何东西能让他们知道在这种情况下该怎么办。

sentences.en: As we will see, they didn't even look the emperor in the eye.
sentences.zh: 正如我们将看到的，他们甚至不敢直视皇帝的眼睛。

sentences.en: The emperor doesn't meet their eye when he talks to them.
sentences.zh: 皇帝在和他们说话时，也不会与他们对视。

sentences.en: So the idea that these guys would have laid hands on him, dragged him out of his litter, and then forced him to sleep next to them, that's surely the biggest twist of all.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些人竟然敢对他动手，把他从轿子里拖出来，还强迫他睡在他们旁边，这绝对是最离谱的反转。

sentences.en: Now, you mentioned that Huascar was being brought north under guard.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到瓦斯卡尔（Huascar）正被押送北上。

sentences.en: In a cage, yes.
sentences.zh: 关在笼子里，是的。

sentences.en: So Pizarro, when Atahualpa tells him this, Pizarro says, do not harm your brother, because Pizarro obviously thinks, wow, if I get both of them?
sentences.zh: 所以当阿塔瓦尔帕告诉皮萨罗这件事时，皮萨罗说，不要伤害你弟弟，因为皮萨罗显然在想，哇，如果我把他们两个都抓到手呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Can make them fight.
sentences.zh: 可以让他们互相残杀。

sentences.en: Well, sleep with one on each side.
sentences.zh: 嗯，一边睡一个。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: But Atahualpa has no intention of allowing his brother to fall into the Spanish hands, because of course he worries that they might prefer his brother.
sentences.zh: 但阿塔瓦尔帕无意让他的弟弟落入西班牙人手中，因为他当然担心他们可能会更偏向他弟弟。

sentences.en: So he sends orders to the people who are bringing Huascar up at a place called Andamarca, which is south of Kayamarca in the mountains.
sentences.zh: 所以他向那些押送瓦斯卡尔的人下令，地点在安达马卡（Andamarca），那是卡哈马卡以南的山区。

sentences.en: Huascar is murdered by his guards, and his body is thrown into the river.
sentences.zh: 瓦斯卡尔被守卫谋杀，尸体被扔进了河里。

sentences.en: So that's a great example of how Atahualpa, even as a captive, is still able effectively to rule the empire, because all these messengers are going out, taking his commands.
sentences.zh: 这很好地证明了阿塔瓦尔帕即使身陷囹圄，依然能有效地统治帝国，因为所有这些信使都在四处奔走，传达他的命令。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 说得太对了。

sentences.en: And it's also a good example of how Atahualpa is not this sort of martyr, a saintly martyr.
sentences.zh: 这也很好地说明了阿塔瓦尔帕并不是那种圣人般的殉道者。

sentences.en: Atahualpa is a very hard man.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕是个非常冷酷的人。

sentences.en: No, I think we've established he's not a saintly martyr.
sentences.zh: 不，我想我们已经确定他不是什么圣人殉道者了。

sentences.en: So Atahualpa sends orders, carry on with the hits, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以阿塔瓦尔帕下令，基本上就是继续清理门户。

sentences.en: So some of his other half-brothers, some of his other relatives, are knocked off in the next few weeks.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的一些同父异母的兄弟和其他亲戚在接下来的几周里都被干掉了。

sentences.en: And to us, to subsequent historians, they say, isn't this insane?
sentences.zh: 对我们这些后世的历史学家来说，他们会说，这难道不疯狂吗？

sentences.en: That Atahualpa is still pursuing his crazy factionalism, you know, after he's been taken prisoner in the face of this existential foreign threat.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕在被俘虏、面临这种生存层面的外敌威胁后，竟然还在搞这种疯狂的派系斗争。

sentences.en: But he doesn't think it is an existential foreign threat.
sentences.zh: 但他并不认为这是生存层面的外敌威胁。

sentences.en: He thinks the civil war is the priority, and that hopefully, in the long run, he thinks maybe he could turn this to his advantage.
sentences.zh: 他认为内战才是当务之急，而且他希望从长远来看，也许能把这件事转化为自己的优势。

sentences.en: But I think also, in a civil war, perhaps you hate the people you're fighting much more than you do foreign intruders.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，在内战中，你对敌人的仇恨可能远超对外来入侵者的仇恨。

sentences.en: Yeah, I don't think he hates the Spanish.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我不认为他恨西班牙人。

sentences.en: I think he's completely confused by them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他完全被他们搞糊涂了。

sentences.en: So let's move on a few weeks to January 1533.
sentences.zh: 那么让我们快进几周，来到1533年1月。

sentences.en: A treasure is now arriving in Cajamarca.
sentences.zh: 财宝现在正运抵卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: So that's jugs, plates, bowls, all these things made of gold.
sentences.zh: 那是水罐、盘子、碗，所有这些用金子做的东西。

sentences.en: And the Spanish start breaking them up when they arrive, so they can fit more and more in the room.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人一收到就开始把它们砸碎，这样就能在房间里塞进更多东西。

sentences.en: They want to cram it into the room.
sentences.zh: 他们想把房间塞满。

sentences.en: Atahualpa says to them, what are you doing?
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕对他们说，你们在干什么？

sentences.en: Why are you doing that?
sentences.zh: 为什么要那样做？

sentences.en: I will give you so much gold, you'll be sated with it.
sentences.zh: 我会给你们足够多的金子，让你们心满意足。

sentences.en: But some of the Spanish say, you know, a few weeks have gone by, mate, and we haven't seen as much gold as we hoped.
sentences.zh: 但有些西班牙人说，伙计，几周过去了，我们看到的金子没预想的那么多。

sentences.en: So Atahualpa says, well, I can tell you two places in particular where you'll get gold.
sentences.zh: 于是阿塔瓦尔帕说，好吧，我可以告诉你们两个特别的地方，你们能弄到金子。

sentences.en: And they're two of the most sacred temples in the empire.
sentences.zh: 那是帝国最神圣的两座神庙。

sentences.en: So one of them is the shrine and oracle of Pachacamac, which is near the coast, near what's now Lima.
sentences.zh: 其中一个是帕查卡马克（Pachacamac）的神龛和神谕所，靠近海岸，就在现在的利马附近。

sentences.en: And the other is the sun temple of Coricancha in Cusco.
sentences.zh: 另一个是库斯科的科里坎查（Coricancha）太阳神庙。

sentences.en: I think both of these you mentioned, Tom, in your excellent Christopher Plummer reading.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，我想你在克里斯托弗·普卢默（Christopher Plummer）的朗读中提到过这两个地方。

sentences.en: And the reason
sentences.zh: 而阿塔瓦尔帕之所以

sentences.en: Atahualpa wants to surrender these two places in particular goes back to the point about the civil war.
sentences.zh: 想交出这两个地方，原因还是回到内战的问题上。

sentences.en: So Cusco, the sun temple there, the most famous temple and religious site in the Andean world.
sentences.zh: 库斯科的太阳神庙，那是安第斯世界最著名的神庙和宗教场所。

sentences.en: Why does he want to surrender that?
sentences.zh: 他为什么要交出那个地方？

sentences.en: Because he's probably never even been to Cusco.
sentences.zh: 因为他可能从来没去过库斯科。

sentences.en: Cusco is his brother's city, his brother's heartland.
sentences.zh: 库斯科是他弟弟的城市，是他弟弟的大本营。

sentences.en: Well, he was planning to wipe Cusco out, wasn't he?
sentences.zh: 嗯，他本来就打算铲平库斯科，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So get the Spanish to do it for him.
sentences.zh: 所以让西班牙人代劳。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: He represents the north of this empire, not the south.
sentences.zh: 他代表的是这个帝国的北方，而不是南方。

sentences.en: And he just thinks, well, you know, this is a brilliant way of punishing Cusco for backing my brother.
sentences.zh: 他只是觉得，嗯，这真是惩罚库斯科支持我弟弟的绝妙方法。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, it's like someone in Manchester saying, destroy London.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这就像曼彻斯特有人说，摧毁伦敦一样。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And then the other one, Pachacamac.
sentences.zh: 然后是另一个，帕查卡马克。

sentences.en: Amusingly, the priests at this oracle had made some disastrous predictions.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，这个神谕所的祭司们曾做出过一些灾难性的预言。

sentences.en: They basically had the crystal ball that I used to use in my
sentences.zh: 他们基本上用的就是我以前在

sentences.en: Associated Newspaper stays.
sentences.zh: 联合报社工作时用的那种水晶球。

sentences.en: So they had said, first of all, they had said that his father,
sentences.zh: 他们首先说，他的父亲，

sentences.en: Hwena Kapak, would recover of smallpox.
sentences.zh: 瓦伊纳·卡帕克（Hwena Kapak），会从天花中康复。

sentences.en: He promptly died.
sentences.zh: 结果他很快就死了。

sentences.en: They told Huascar that he would beat Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉瓦斯卡尔他会打败阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: As we've discovered, Huascar ended up in a cage.
sentences.zh: 正如我们所知，瓦斯卡尔最后被关进了笼子。

sentences.en: And they told Atahualpa that foreigners would arrive and he would easily defeat them.
sentences.zh: 他们还告诉阿塔瓦尔帕，外国人会到来，而他会轻易击败他们。

sentences.en: So Huascar says, this oracle is absolutely useless.
sentences.zh: 所以阿塔瓦尔帕说，这个神谕所简直一无是处。

sentences.en: And actually, there's a funny story.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，有个有趣的故事。

sentences.en: The high priest apparently, Pachacamac, went to
sentences.zh: 据说帕查卡马克的大祭司去了

sentences.en: Caimac to see Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 卡哈马卡见阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa upbraided him in front of the Spaniards and said, your predictions are terrible.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕在西班牙人面前斥责他，说，你们的预言太糟糕了。

sentences.en: You know, you're absolutely worthless.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你们简直毫无价值。

sentences.en: Of course,
sentences.zh: 当然，

sentences.en: I'm going to take all your gold.
sentences.zh: 我要拿走你们所有的金子。

sentences.en: You've absolutely shamed yourselves.
sentences.zh: 你们真是丢尽了脸。

sentences.en: But also, isn't Atahualpa has started to fathom Spaniards' religious motivation?
sentences.zh: 但话说回来，阿塔瓦尔帕是不是已经开始摸清西班牙人的宗教动机了？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And he kind of fires them up for sacking these temples by saying that the gods worship, there are demons.
sentences.zh: 他通过说那里供奉的神是恶魔，来煽动他们去洗劫这些神庙。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: So that's another way in which he can get his vengeance on kind of priesthoods that he feel are against his rule.
sentences.zh: 所以这是他向那些他认为反对他统治的祭司阶层复仇的另一种方式。

sentences.en: And actually, the interesting thing is Pachacamac.
sentences.zh: 事实上，有趣的是帕查卡马克。

sentences.en: Pachacamac dates back for more than a thousand years before the Incas.
sentences.zh: 帕查卡马克早在印加人出现前一千多年就存在了。

sentences.en: This is not an Inca shrine.
sentences.zh: 这不是一座印加神龛。

sentences.en: It's part of the Andean world, but it's not part of their official state-sponsored sun religion, which they've been really trying to impose across the empire in recent decades.
sentences.zh: 它是安第斯世界的一部分，但不是他们官方推崇的太阳崇拜的一部分，而那种崇拜是他们近几十年来一直试图在帝国各地强行推行的。

sentences.en: There's a slight kind of owl man quality to it as well, isn't there?
sentences.zh: 这听起来还有点像猫头鹰人的传说，不是吗？

sentences.en: So the owl man is the figure in the Aztec story where, you know, you unleash the owl man and the world will end, but at least you'll destroy your enemies.
sentences.zh: 猫头鹰人是阿兹特克故事里的角色，你知道，一旦释放猫头鹰人，世界就会终结，但至少你能摧毁你的敌人。

sentences.en: And he gets shot and that's the end of the owl man.
sentences.zh: 然后他被射杀，猫头鹰人的故事就结束了。

sentences.en: There's a prophecy that if the temple at Pachacamac is attacked, then a universal flood would wipe out the entire world.
sentences.zh: 有一个预言说，如果帕查卡马克的神庙遭到攻击，一场全球洪水就会毁灭整个世界。

sentences.en: Oh, that's right.
sentences.zh: 哦，没错。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And therefore, if, you know, tribute isn't paid to this temple, then it will be disastrous.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果不对这座神庙进贡，就会发生灾难。

sentences.en: So essentially, the Spanish, by sending people to loot it, are putting that prophecy to the teSt.
sentences.zh: 所以本质上，西班牙人派人去洗劫它，是在考验那个预言。

sentences.en: And if they're wrong, then a universal flood will destroy all of life on earth.
sentences.zh: 如果他们错了，那么一场全球洪水就会毁灭地球上所有的生命。

sentences.en: So the stakes are quite high.
sentences.zh: 所以赌注相当大。

sentences.en: They are high.
sentences.zh: 确实很大。

sentences.en: So Pizarro sends his brother Hernando to this shrine at Pachacamac on the coaSt. And it's
sentences.zh: 于是皮萨罗派他的兄弟埃尔南多（Hernando）去海岸边的帕查卡马克神龛。很高兴他这么做了，

sentences.en: good for us that he did, because some of the guys that went with Hernando wrote these fantastic memoirs of the conqueSt. So a guy called Miguel de Estete.
sentences.zh: 因为随埃尔南多去的一些人写下了关于征服的精彩回忆录。比如一个叫米格尔·德·埃斯特特（Miguel de Estete）的人。

sentences.en: And they write these really, there's some of the first kind of really lyrical descriptions of the South American landscape.
sentences.zh: 他们写下了最早的一些对南美景观真正富有诗意的描述。

sentences.en: There's a brilliant description of the road over the Andes.
sentences.zh: 书中对翻越安第斯山脉的道路有精彩的描写。

sentences.en: And the highlands are described as truly a land so muddy that it's like has not been seen in Christendom.
sentences.zh: 高地被描述为一片泥泞的土地，简直是基督教世界从未见过的景象。

sentences.en: So they've obviously not been to Somerset in January.
sentences.zh: 显然他们没去过一月份的萨默塞特郡。

sentences.en: No, clearly not.
sentences.zh: 不，显然没有。

sentences.en: So they go to the sanctuary.
sentences.zh: 所以他们去了圣所。

sentences.en: And Estete said, it was basically the top of an adobe pyramid.
sentences.zh: 埃斯特特说，那基本上就是一座土坯金字塔的顶部。

sentences.en: And he was very underwhelmed by it.
sentences.zh: 他对此感到非常失望。

sentences.en: He said, it was very dark, and it didn't smell very pleasant.
sentences.zh: 他说，那里非常黑暗，闻起来也不太好闻。

sentences.en: A very small, rough cavern.
sentences.zh: 一个非常狭小、粗糙的洞穴。

sentences.en: Seeing the filth and mockery of the idol, we went out to ask why they thought highly of something so dirty and ugly.
sentences.zh: 看到偶像的肮脏和荒谬，我们走出来问他们为什么会崇拜如此肮脏丑陋的东西。

sentences.en: And actually, there was no treasure there at all.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，那里根本没有任何财宝。

sentences.en: If there was any treasure, the priests had hidden it.
sentences.zh: 如果有财宝的话，祭司们也早就藏起来了。

sentences.en: And the Spanish, they just smashed the whole place up.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人就把整个地方砸了个稀巴烂。

sentences.en: And is there a universal flood?
sentences.zh: 那么有全球洪水吗？

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，完全没有。

sentences.en: So Anando then sets off back to Cajamarca.
sentences.zh: 于是埃尔南多动身返回卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: And actually, the distances in this story are absolutely mad.
sentences.zh: 而且实际上，这个故事里的距离简直疯狂。

sentences.en: So Anando has just traveled 800 miles.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多刚刚走了800英里。

sentences.en: He's got
sentences.zh: 他还有

sentences.en: 800 miles to go back.
sentences.zh: 800英里的路要走回去。

sentences.en: And he's going back to Cajamarca.
sentences.zh: 他正准备回到卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: And then he discovers that at a place called Xausa, Atahualpa's commander-in-chief, this guy Chalkuchima, is blocking the mountain road with about 35,000 men.
sentences.zh: 随后他发现，在豪萨（Xausa）这个地方，阿塔瓦尔帕的最高指挥官查尔库奇马（Chalkuchima）正率领约35000名士兵封锁了山路。

sentences.en: Now, Chalkuchima is the most experienced of all Atahualpa's generals.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马是阿塔瓦尔帕所有将军中经验最丰富的一位。

sentences.en: He's basically the sort of, the grizzled veteran character in a sort of fantasy novel or something.
sentences.zh: 他基本上就像那种奇幻小说里饱经风霜的老兵角色。

sentences.en: I served your father.
sentences.zh: 我曾效忠于你的父亲。

sentences.en: You know, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's his vibe.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的气场。

sentences.en: So the kind of character who is honorable, but ultimately doomed, would you say, in a science fiction story.
sentences.zh: 所以，在科幻故事里，你会说他是那种虽然光荣但最终注定失败的角色吗？

sentences.en: Completely.
sentences.zh: 完全是。

sentences.en: That's completely what he is.
sentences.zh: 他就是那种人。

sentences.en: Exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: So he's like that sort of
sentences.zh: 所以他就像是那种……

sentences.en: Jorah Mormont or whatever in Game of Thrones, that sort of figure.
sentences.zh: 《权力的游戏》里的乔拉·莫尔蒙之类的角色。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So John Hemming says Chalkuchima is the one man who might have united the empire against the Spaniards because he's the one man who's not entirely defined by the Civil War
sentences.zh: 约翰·赫明（John Hemming）说，查尔库奇马是唯一可能团结帝国对抗西班牙人的人，因为他是唯一一个没有完全被内战定义的人，

sentences.en: because he had served Atahualpa's father.
sentences.zh: 因为他曾效忠于阿塔瓦尔帕的父亲。

sentences.en: So in other words, what Chalkuchima does now is very important.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，查尔库奇马现在的行动非常重要。

sentences.en: Anando arrives in Chausa with his men.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多（Anando）带着他的人马抵达了豪萨。

sentences.en: They've done this mad journey.
sentences.zh: 他们完成了一段疯狂的旅程。

sentences.en: They've climbed 16,000 feet up into the Andes.
sentences.zh: 他们攀登了16000英尺高，进入了安第斯山脉。

sentences.en: They've been trudging through snow.
sentences.zh: 他们一直在雪地里艰难跋涉。

sentences.en: They're absolutely shattered.
sentences.zh: 他们已经彻底精疲力竭了。

sentences.en: There are only a few dozen of them, and Chalkuchima has more than 30,000 men.
sentences.zh: 他们只有几十个人，而查尔库奇马有超过30000名士兵。

sentences.en: They arrive in Jauja, and there's this festival going on.
sentences.zh: 他们到达豪萨时，那里正在举行节日庆典。

sentences.en: So there's people dancing and singing, and they sort of ignore the Spanish.
sentences.zh: 人们在载歌载舞，他们似乎无视了西班牙人。

sentences.en: So the Spanish hang around a bit, and then finally,
sentences.zh: 所以西班牙人在那儿徘徊了一会儿，最后，

sentences.en: Chalkuchima arrives with his senior officers.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马带着他的高级军官们出现了。

sentences.en: We have a description of him from the later chronicler, Tieta de Leon, who says he was a muscular man with a broad back, a fierce expression, and a short, very thick neck.
sentences.zh: 我们有后来编年史家蒂塔·德·莱昂（Tieta de Leon）对他的描述，他说他是一个肌肉发达、背部宽阔、表情凶猛、脖子又短又粗的男人。

sentences.en: So he looks like a rugby player, basically.
sentences.zh: 所以他基本上看起来像个橄榄球运动员。

sentences.en: Anando says to Chalkuchima, you know, Atahualpa wants you to come with us to Kayamaka.
sentences.zh: 埃尔南多对查尔库奇马说，你知道，阿塔瓦尔帕希望你和我们一起去卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: And Chalkuchima says, no, no, what?
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马说，不，不，什么？

sentences.en: I'm not going with you.
sentences.zh: 我不会跟你们走的。

sentences.en: I haven't had any orders to say I should go with you.
sentences.zh: 我没有接到任何命令说我应该跟你们走。

sentences.en: They have a massive argument all night.
sentences.zh: 他们整晚都在激烈争吵。

sentences.en: The Spanish think, well, if he doesn't, if he attacks us, we're pretty much doomed because he's got 30,000 men and we've got sort of, you know, 20 men or something.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人想，好吧，如果他不走，如果他攻击我们，我们基本就死定了，因为他有30000人，而我们只有20人左右。

sentences.en: But the mad thing is when the dawn breaks, Chalkuchima returns and says, yeah, actually, I've been thinking about it.
sentences.zh: 但疯狂的是，当黎明破晓时，查尔库奇马回来了，说，好吧，其实我考虑过了。

sentences.en: I will come with you to Kayamaka.
sentences.zh: 我会和你们一起去卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: Fair enough.
sentences.zh: 那还差不多。

sentences.en: One possible influence on him, do you think, is the fact that the local people here are anti-Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 你认为对他产生影响的一个可能因素是，当地人是反阿塔瓦尔帕的吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So they had not been backing them.
sentences.zh: 所以他们一直没有支持他们。

sentences.en: And these are the wanker people.
sentences.zh: 这些人是万卡人（Wanka）。

sentences.en: Do you know, I actually, I omitted all mention of these people.
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，我其实省略了所有关于这些人的提及。

sentences.en: The wanker.
sentences.zh: 万卡人。

sentences.en: For precisely this reason, because I thought you would get too much.
sentences.zh: 正是因为这个原因，因为我觉得你会反应过度。

sentences.en: I didn't find it funny at all.
sentences.zh: 我一点也不觉得好笑。

sentences.en: School boyish pleasure from the existence of these people.
sentences.zh: 从这些人的存在中获得小学生般的乐趣。

sentences.en: There's nothing funny about it, but I think the role of the wanker in this story is one that, you know, we shouldn't overlook.
sentences.zh: 这没什么好笑的，但我认为万卡人在这个故事中的角色是不容忽视的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, and indeed in this podcast, we shouldn't overlook it at all.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事实上在这个播客里，我们完全不应该忽视它。

sentences.en: Because the wankers will be back, won't they?
sentences.zh: 因为万卡人还会回来的，不是吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Well, they will.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们会回来的。

sentences.en: I mean, I was hoping they won't, but clearly you're going to bring them back in.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我希望他们不会，但显然你会把他们带回来。

sentences.en: It's all about detail, probably.
sentences.zh: 这可能全在于细节。

sentences.en: It's about the granular level.
sentences.zh: 这是关于颗粒度层面的问题。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So anyway, why has Chalkuchima, he hasn't just done it because of the presence of the wanker.
sentences.zh: 总之，为什么查尔库奇马会这么做？他不仅仅是因为万卡人的存在才这么做的。

sentences.en: He's also going with them, I think, because he's been completely thrown by the Spaniards presence, by their very existence.
sentences.zh: 我想他跟着他们走，也是因为他被西班牙人的出现，被他们本身的存在彻底搞糊涂了。

sentences.en: He doesn't know what to do.
sentences.zh: 他不知道该怎么办。

sentences.en: When they say Atauelpa has sent for you, I mean, he's taking a risk if he doesn't go.
sentences.zh: 当他们说阿塔瓦尔帕传唤你时，我的意思是，如果他不走，他就是在冒险。

sentences.en: So he decides he'll go with them.
sentences.zh: 所以他决定跟他们走。

sentences.en: And as John Hemming says, this decision was a tragic mistake, one of the turning points in the collapse of resistance of the Spanish invaders.
sentences.zh: 正如约翰·赫明所说，这个决定是一个悲剧性的错误，是西班牙入侵者抵抗力量崩溃的转折点之一。

sentences.en: For by riding out of Chaucha with this deceptively small band of strangers,
sentences.zh: 因为带着这群看似弱小的陌生人骑马离开豪萨，

sentences.en: Chalkuchima delivered himself into captivity and death.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马将自己送入了囚禁和死亡之中。

sentences.en: Oh, dear.
sentences.zh: 噢，天哪。

sentences.en: But not at firSt.
sentences.zh: 但起初并非如此。

sentences.en: So at first, they treat him with tremendous friendship and they ride together across the great scenery of the Cordillera Blanca, past the sources of the Amazon, all this kind of
sentences.zh: 起初，他们对他表现出极大的友好，他们一起骑马穿过布兰卡山脉（Cordillera Blanca）的壮丽景色，经过亚马逊河的源头，所有这些事情。

sentences.en: thing.
sentences.zh: 然后他们终于到达了卡哈马卡，其他的西班牙人说，噢，太棒了。

sentences.en: And they finally get to Cajamarca and the other Spaniards say, oh, brilliant.
sentences.zh: 是的，你回来了。

sentences.en: Yeah, you're back.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Great to see you.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马此时可能开始想，我跟这些人走的选择对吗？

sentences.en: Chalkuchima at this point probably is beginning to think, did I make the right choice in game with these guys?
sentences.zh: 因为他们把他带到了阿塔瓦尔帕面前。

sentences.en: Because they take him into Seattle, Welper.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马见到伟大的印加王时，情绪激动。

sentences.en: Chalkuchima is overcome with emotion to see the great Inca.
sentences.zh: 他，引用原文，向太阳举起双手，感谢能再次见到他。

sentences.en: And he, and I quote, raised his hands to the sun to give thanks for being allowed to see him again.
sentences.zh: 他怀着极大的敬意走近他，哭泣着亲吻他的脸、手和脚。

sentences.en: He went up to him with great reverence, weeping and kissed him on the face, hands and feet.
sentences.zh: 随他而来的其他酋长也做了同样的事。

sentences.en: And the other chiefs who had come with him did the same.
sentences.zh: 但阿塔瓦尔帕甚至不看他的脸。

sentences.en: But Atahualpa won't even look him in the face.
sentences.zh: 这在印加是常态。

sentences.en: Now, this is standard for the Inca.
sentences.zh: 印加王通常不会直视平民的眼睛，但西班牙人能看出阿塔瓦尔帕心碎了，他最好的指挥官就这样直接走进了囚笼。

sentences.en: The Inca doesn't normally look at commoners in the eyes, but the Spanish can see that Atahualpa is gutted, that his best commander has just walked straight into captivity.
sentences.zh: 就在他身边。

sentences.en: Alongside him.
sentences.zh: 事实上，现在对查尔库奇马来说，他那些西班牙朋友脸上的笑容开始消失了。

sentences.en: And actually now for Chalkuchima, the smiles on the faces of his Spanish friends begin to fade.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，阿塔瓦尔帕没有给他传话让他别去。

sentences.en: It is odd that Atahualpa didn't send him a message to say, don't do it.
sentences.zh: 当你只能通过结绳记事来交流时，这很难，不是吗？

sentences.en: It's hard when you're communicating only by knotted strings, no?
sentences.zh: 是的，我想是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I suppose.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果他们发展出文字，也许故事会不同。

sentences.en: I mean, this is the issue if they develop writing and maybe a different story.
sentences.zh: 所以西班牙人现在对查尔库奇马说，好了，你知道，现在我们要动真格的了。

sentences.en: So the Spanish now say to Chalkuchima, right, you know, the gloves are off now.
sentences.zh: 你的黄金在哪里？

sentences.en: Where's your gold?
sentences.zh: 我们想要更多的黄金。

sentences.en: We would like more of your gold.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马说，我没有。

sentences.en: And Chalkuchima said, I don't have any.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我有什么黄金，我都带来了。

sentences.en: I mean, what gold I have, I brought with me.
sentences.zh: 索托（Soto）和我们的人把他拉到一边，威胁要烧死他，除非他说实话。

sentences.en: Soto, and we told, took him aside and threatened to burn him unless he told the truth.
sentences.zh: 他给出了和之前一样的回答。

sentences.en: He gave the same answer as before.
sentences.zh: 他们立起一根柱子，把他绑在上面，拿来柴火和稻草，说如果他不讲实话，就要把他烧死。

sentences.en: They put up a stake and tied him to it and brought firewood and straw, saying they would set fire to him unless he told the truth.
sentences.zh: 然后发生了这可怕的一幕。

sentences.en: Then there's this terrible scene.
sentences.zh: 查尔库奇马崩溃了，他说，把皇帝叫来。

sentences.en: Chalkuchima kind of breaks down and he says, get the emperor.
sentences.zh: 他们带出了皇帝。

sentences.en: They bring out the emperor.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕出来说，别担心，别听这些西班牙人的。

sentences.en: Atahualpa comes out and says, don't worry, don't listen to these Spanish.
sentences.zh: 他们在虚张声势。

sentences.en: They're bluffing.
sentences.zh: 他们不会烧死你的。

sentences.en: They won't burn you.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人可能真的点燃了他。

sentences.en: The Spanish probably set him on fire.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知。

sentences.en: And we're told.
sentences.zh: 一阵阵笑声。

sentences.en: Gusts of laughter.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，他们把他放了下来，拖到了埃尔南多·皮萨罗（Hernando Pizarro）的住处。

sentences.en: They cut him down after a few moments and they dragged him to Hernando Pizarro's lodging.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是那个一直和他一起旅行的家伙。

sentences.en: So this is the bloke who's been traveling with him.
sentences.zh: 引用原文，他的腿和手臂被烧焦，筋腱萎缩。

sentences.en: Quote, his legs and arms burned and his tendons shriveled.
sentences.zh: 我们被告知埃尔南多对他还不错，还照顾了他。

sentences.en: And we're told that Hernando was quite nice to him and tended him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，事实证明这是一项西班牙人掌握的技能，不是吗？

sentences.en: I mean, this is a skill it turns out the Spaniards have, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 就是把人体烧到恰到好处的程度。

sentences.en: Is burning human bodies to just the right degree.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢烧烤。

sentences.en: I like grilling.
sentences.zh: 他还没死，但我必须告诉你，对于查尔库奇马，甚至对于阿塔瓦尔帕来说，结局都不会太美好。

sentences.en: He's not dead, but I have to tell you that for Chalkuchima and indeed for Atahualpa, there is not going to be a very happy ending.
sentences.zh: 所以我想就此打住，我们该休息一下了。

sentences.en: So I think on that note, we should take a break.
sentences.zh: 还有很多悬念，休息过后，我们将揭晓谁会获胜，是西班牙人还是阿塔瓦尔帕。

sentences.en: There is so much to play for and we will find out who triumphs, the Spaniards or Atahualpa after the break.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到《读书俱乐部》（The Book Club），这是Goalhanger推出的新播客，由我多米尼克·桑德布鲁克（Dominic Sandbrook）主持。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome to The Book Club, a new podcast from Goalhanger, hosted by me, Dominic Sandbrook.
sentences.zh: 还有我，塔比莎·西罗德（Tabitha Syrod）。

sentences.en: And me, Tabitha Syrod.
sentences.zh: 你们中有些人可能知道，我曾是多米尼克在《历史的余味》（The Rest is History）节目中的制作人，去年我们甚至做了一个关于书籍的迷你系列节目。

sentences.en: As some of you may know, I've been Dominic's producer on The Rest is History, and we even did a mini-series last year about all things books.
sentences.zh: 既然我们非常享受那个过程，我们决定把它作为一个独立的节目推出。

sentences.zh: 所以它会在每周二播出。

sentences.en: So it'll be coming out every Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 我们每次会讨论一本书，深入挖掘书背后的所有故事。

sentences.en: We'll be doing a different book each time and digging into all the stories behind them.

sentences.en: And we are going to be talking about the historical contexts behind some of the greatest and most famous books of all time.
sentences.zh: 我们将深入挖掘它们背后非凡的人物，故事背后的意外故事，

sentences.en: We're going to be digging into the remarkable people behind them, the unexpected stories behind
sentences.zh: 同时也会稍微梳理一下每本书的情节，深入探讨故事的内涵。

sentences.en: the stories, and also unraveling the plot of each book a bit and delving into the depths of the story.

sentences.en: Now, you don't have to have read the books to listen to the show, but we hope that by the end of each episode, you will be able to pretend to people that you've read them.

sentences.en: That is the key thing.
sentences.zh: 无论如何，不管你读没读过，我们都希望你能学到很多迷人的事实。

sentences.en: And either way, whether you read them or not, we hope that you'll learn lots of fascinating facts.
sentences.zh: 你会听到很多精彩的故事。

sentences.en: You'll do lots of great stories.
sentences.zh: 也许，塔比，还会偶尔笑一笑。

sentences.en: And maybe, Tabi, the odd laugh.

sentences.en: Hello, and welcome back to The Rest is History.
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《历史的余味》。

sentences.en: It is April 1533, and for weeks now, the gold of the Incas has been rolling into this room that has a white line around it.
sentences.zh: 时间是1533年4月，几周以来，印加人的黄金源源不断地涌入这个画着白线的房间。

sentences.en: The gold has to reach that white line, or else Atahualpa is going to be killed.
sentences.zh: 黄金必须堆到那条白线，否则阿塔瓦尔帕就会被处死。

sentences.en: And Dominic, every day that hoard is getting higher, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，那堆宝藏每天都在升高，对吧？

sentences.en: Because you've got streams of porters, streams of llamas, and they are just bringing in gold from across Peru and beyond.
sentences.zh: 因为你有一队队搬运工、一群群骆马，正从秘鲁各地乃至更远的地方源源不断地运来黄金。

sentences.en: They are, and Atahualpa is watching with great satisfaction, because with every new convoy, surely the day of his freedom is approaching.
sentences.zh: 确实如此，阿塔瓦尔帕正满怀满足地看着这一切，因为随着每一批新货物的到来，他离自由的日子肯定更近了。

sentences.en: But the gold porters are not the only new arrivals in Cajamarca.
sentences.zh: 但卡哈马卡的这些新来者可不止是运送黄金的搬运工。

sentences.en: Just before Easter, a familiar face joins this merry party.
sentences.zh: 就在复活节前夕，一个熟悉的面孔加入了这场热闹的聚会。

sentences.en: And this is Pizarro's business partner, Diego del Magro.
sentences.zh: 他就是皮萨罗的商业合伙人，迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We described in episode one, he's short, he's ugly, he's flamboyant, so he's colourfully dressed, but he's also very boastful and sort of boorish.
sentences.zh: 我们在第一集里描述过，他个子矮、长得丑、性格张扬，所以穿得花里胡哨，但他也非常爱吹牛，而且有点粗鲁。

sentences.en: John Rhys Davies.
sentences.zh: 约翰·里斯-戴维斯。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Who played Gimli.
sentences.zh: 就是扮演金雳的那位。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Now, remember, the deal was that he would get reinforcements in Panama, and he would come along later.
sentences.zh: 现在要记住，当时的协议是他负责在巴拿马招募援军，随后赶来。

sentences.en: And this is precisely what he's done.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他所做的。

sentences.en: He's arrived with 150 Spaniards with a load more horses, and some royal officials who are basically going to report back to the court in Spain, to Charles V.
sentences.zh: 他带来了150名西班牙人，还有更多的马匹，以及一些名义上要向西班牙王室、向查理五世汇报的官员。

sentences.en: So this has massive implications now for both Pizarro and Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 所以这对皮萨罗和阿塔瓦尔帕来说，现在都有了巨大的影响。

sentences.en: So Pizarro now has his business partner on hand, who he has screwed over from the very beginning
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗现在有了他的商业合伙人在场，而他从一开始就把对方坑得够呛，

sentences.en: because he got himself the title of governor, but basically, was it a commandant of a fort or something?
sentences.zh: 因为他自己弄到了总督的头衔，但对方呢，基本上只是个堡垒指挥官之类的？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The title for his business partner.
sentences.zh: 这就是他合伙人的头衔。

sentences.en: And Almagro, throughout this whole thing, he's paranoid that he's going to be cut out of the loot.
sentences.zh: 阿尔马格罗在整个过程中一直担心自己会被踢出分赃的行列。

sentences.en: Now, Atahualpa, when he sees these guys arrive, he obviously needs to recalibrate, because clearly,
sentences.zh: 现在，阿塔瓦尔帕看到这些人到来时，显然需要重新评估局势，因为很明显，

sentences.en: there are a lot more Spaniards out there, and he can tell they're not just going to go away when they've got the gold.
sentences.zh: 外面还有更多的西班牙人，他看得出来，他们拿到黄金后并不会就此离开。

sentences.en: This is not just a raid.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一次突袭。

sentences.en: This looks more like an invasion.
sentences.zh: 这看起来更像是一场入侵。

sentences.en: And at this point, Atahualpa says to Pizarro, are you going home or are you going to stay?
sentences.zh: 就在这时，阿塔瓦尔帕问皮萨罗：你们是要回家，还是打算留下来？

sentences.en: I mean, it's been great having you, but, you know.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有你们在当然很好，但是，你知道的。

sentences.en: When are you leaving?
sentences.zh: 你们什么时候走？

sentences.en: Should I check out the train times?
sentences.zh: 我是不是该去查查火车时刻表？

sentences.en: And for the first time, Pizarro says to him, we are going to stay, and we are going to divide up your workers, your people, among ourselves.
sentences.zh: 这是皮萨罗第一次对他说：我们要留下来，而且我们要把你们的劳工、你们的人民瓜分掉。

sentences.en: And this is a huge shock for Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 这对阿塔瓦尔帕来说是一个巨大的打击。

sentences.en: Pizarro says, don't worry, we will leave the northern bit, the province of Quito, to you.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗说，别担心，我们会把北部地区，也就是基多省留给你。

sentences.en: That's your heartland.
sentences.zh: 那是你的核心领地。

sentences.en: It'll be your kingdom.
sentences.zh: 那将是你的王国。

sentences.en: But Atahualpa, for the first time, thinks, I don't believe these guys.
sentences.zh: 但阿塔瓦尔帕第一次心想：我不相信这些人。

sentences.en: They are not going to want a disagreement.
sentences.zh: 他们不会想要什么分歧的。

sentences.en: And is he starting to think, can I even trust them to set me free when the line gets reached?
sentences.zh: 他开始怀疑，当黄金堆到那条线时，我真的能相信他们会放我走吗？

sentences.en: Exactly, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实如此。

sentences.en: Now, all the time, the gold has been rolling in, as you said.
sentences.zh: 正如你所说，黄金一直在源源不断地运来。

sentences.en: And at the first week of May, 1533, Pizarro orders his men to start melting it down.
sentences.zh: 1533年5月的第一周，皮萨罗下令手下开始熔化这些黄金。

sentences.en: This is an incredible operation.
sentences.zh: 这是一项令人难以置信的工程。

sentences.en: They've built nine huge forges under Spanish supervision.
sentences.zh: 他们在西班牙人的监督下建造了九个巨大的熔炉。

sentences.en: Inca smiths are going to do it.
sentences.zh: 由印加工匠来操作。

sentences.en: And they are feeding the fires all day, all night, seven days a week, for seven weeks, with more than 600 pounds of gold a day.
sentences.zh: 他们没日没夜地生火，每周七天，持续七周，每天熔化超过600磅的黄金。

sentences.en: So that's a total of 11 tons.
sentences.zh: 总计达到了11吨。

sentences.en: And we're talking about vases, figurines, idols, ornaments, necklaces, you name it.
sentences.zh: 我们说的是花瓶、小雕像、偶像、装饰品、项链，应有尽有。

sentences.en: These are beautiful artifacts, because we know from the very few that were preserved, the high standard of Andean kind of gold craftsmanship.
sentences.zh: 这些都是精美的艺术品，因为从仅存的少数几件中，我们知道安第斯地区的黄金工艺水平极高。

sentences.en: Such a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 真是太可惜了。

sentences.en: Imagine what it would be like to have those things.
sentences.zh: 想象一下拥有那些东西会是什么感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And the Spanish turned them into bars that would be stamped with the royal symbol.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人把它们熔成了印有王室标志的金条。

sentences.en: And, you know, there are going to be 13,500 pounds of gold bars, 16,000 pounds of silver bars, which are all destined to be shipped back to Spain.
sentences.zh: 你知道，总共会有13500磅的金条和16000磅的银条，这些都注定要被运回西班牙。

sentences.en: Now, you'll remember that I mentioned that Atualpa had offered them two temples.
sentences.zh: 你还记得我提到过阿塔瓦尔帕曾向他们提供过两座神庙吗？

sentences.en: So one is Pachokamak, which we talked about last time, and the other was the Sun Temple of Coricancha in Cusco.
sentences.zh: 一座是帕查卡马克，我们上次谈到过，另一座是库斯科的科里坎查太阳神庙。

sentences.en: And he has now persuaded Pizarro, send some men to Cusco, to the Sun Temple.
sentences.zh: 他现在已经说服了皮萨罗，派人去库斯科的太阳神庙。

sentences.en: Cusco is a hell of a long way away, 750 miles across the central Andes.
sentences.zh: 库斯科离这儿远得要命，要跨越750英里的安第斯山脉中部。

sentences.en: Not for people who've been going 800 miles.
sentences.zh: 对于那些已经走了800英里的人来说不算什么。

sentences.en: Well, I guess.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想也是。

sentences.en: Yeah, except you're going across the mountains, which is hard.
sentences.zh: 是啊，除了你要翻越山脉，那可是很难的。

sentences.en: Yeah, true.
sentences.zh: 没错，确实。

sentences.en: So when he gets a message from Hernando, his brother, to say,
sentences.zh: 所以当他收到他兄弟埃尔南多的消息说，

sentences.en: Pachokamak is no good, there's no gold, Pizarro says, okay, fine, we'll do it.
sentences.zh: 帕查卡马克那边不行，没有黄金，皮萨罗说，好吧，没问题，我们去库斯科。

sentences.en: And he sends three volunteers.
sentences.zh: 于是他派了三名志愿者。

sentences.en: Three.
sentences.zh: 三名。

sentences.en: I know, three volunteers with an escort all the way across the Andes, south to Cusco.
sentences.zh: 我知道，三名志愿者带着护卫队，一路翻越安第斯山脉，南下前往库斯科。

sentences.en: And they get there in early April, and they're greeted by Atualpa's general, Kis-Kis, who is occupying Cusco.
sentences.zh: 他们在4月初到达那里，受到了正在占领库斯科的阿塔瓦尔帕将军基斯基斯的迎接。

sentences.en: Now, we'll talk a lot about Cusco next time, so we don't need to massively go into it now.
sentences.zh: 我们下次会详细讨论库斯科，所以现在不需要深入探讨。

sentences.en: But just to talk about the temple, Codacantra, this was the holiest place that there was for the Incas.
sentences.zh: 但就说说那座神庙，科里坎查，那是印加人最神圣的地方。

sentences.en: It's the Temple of the Sun.
sentences.zh: 那是太阳神庙。

sentences.en: The Inca, of course, is the Son of the Sun.
sentences.zh: 印加王当然就是太阳之子。

sentences.en: There is this herb garden, there's a convent, there's an astronomical observatory.
sentences.zh: 那里有药草园、修道院，还有一个天文台。

sentences.en: John Hemming calls it the Mecca of the Inca Empire, because pilgrims would come from all over the Andes to visit this place.
sentences.zh: 约翰·赫明称其为印加帝国的麦加，因为朝圣者会从安第斯山脉各地来到这里。

sentences.en: And even though Kis-Kis is a northerner who's put Cusco under military occupation, he's shocked when the Spaniards say, we've come to basically rip out the gold from this temple.
sentences.zh: 尽管基斯基斯是一个北方人，对库斯科实行了军事占领，但当西班牙人说我们要把这座神庙里的黄金洗劫一空时，他还是感到震惊。

sentences.en: I mean, imagine, you know, they turn up in Mecca and say, we've been sent to despoil the mosque.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，想象一下，他们出现在麦加，说我们是奉命来洗劫清真寺的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: That didn't go down well.
sentences.zh: 那可不会有什么好结果。

sentences.en: Not at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不会。

sentences.en: And they're very rude.
sentences.zh: 而且他们非常粗鲁。

sentences.en: He's very shocked that they're uncouth, and they abuse the women of the temples.
sentences.zh: 他非常震惊于他们的粗野，而且他们还凌辱了神庙里的妇女。

sentences.en: That's all we're told.
sentences.zh: 我们只知道这些。

sentences.en: I think we can guess, given the Spanish behavior earlier in the last episode, exactly how badly behaved they are with the women of the temples.
sentences.zh: 考虑到上一集里西班牙人的表现，我想我们可以猜到他们对神庙里的妇女行为有多恶劣。

sentences.en: Seems incomprehensible they're not just lynched.
sentences.zh: 真难以理解他们竟然没被当场处死。

sentences.en: I know, and there's only three of them.
sentences.zh: 我知道，而且他们只有三个人。

sentences.en: Insane, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 太疯狂了，不是吗？

sentences.en: And the mad thing is, Kis-Kis says, okay, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 最疯狂的是，基斯基斯竟然说，好吧，没问题。

sentences.en: And his men fetch tools so that these Spanish guys with crowbars can take these giant gold plates off the walls of the temples.
sentences.zh: 他的手下找来了工具，让这些拿着撬棍的西班牙人把神庙墙上那些巨大的金板拆了下来。

sentences.en: I mean, isn't it that Kis-Kis is actually, he's in command of an occupying force?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，基斯基斯不是正指挥着一支占领军吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: And presumably shares Atahualpa's contempt for what Cuzco represents.
sentences.zh: 而且大概也认同阿塔瓦尔帕对库斯科所代表事物的蔑视。

sentences.en: I'm sure.
sentences.zh: 我肯定。

sentences.en: So in a sense, maybe the Spaniards are doing dirty work that he can't actually do.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种意义上说，也许西班牙人在做他自己不方便做的脏活。

sentences.en: I suppose, maybe.
sentences.zh: 我想也许吧。

sentences.en: Because I cannot comprehend how they would be allowed to do this otherwise.
sentences.zh: 因为我实在无法理解，否则他们怎么可能被允许这样做。

sentences.en: Yeah, maybe.
sentences.zh: 是啊，也许吧。

sentences.en: I mean, I think the fact that he's a northerner definitely is a factor, and he's commanding an occupying army.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为他是北方人这一点绝对是一个因素，而且他指挥着一支占领军。

sentences.en: But even so, he's part of the Inca world.
sentences.zh: 但即便如此，他也是印加世界的一部分。

sentences.en: He believes in the cult of the sun.
sentences.zh: 他信仰太阳崇拜。

sentences.en: You know, he's part of that cosmological ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他是那个宇宙生态系统的一部分。

sentences.en: But they tear it all down.
sentences.zh: 但他们把一切都拆毁了。

sentences.en: So these great plates, they're about two and a half feet long.
sentences.zh: 这些巨大的金板大约有两英尺半长。

sentences.en: They weigh five pounds each.
sentences.zh: 每块重五磅。

sentences.en: They're beautifully decorated, we're told, with images of trees and flowers and things like that.
sentences.zh: 据说上面装饰着精美的树木、花卉之类的图案。

sentences.en: Solid gold.
sentences.zh: 纯金的。

sentences.en: The Spaniards tear it all down.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人把它们全部拆了下来。

sentences.en: They get hundreds of porters to carry it back.
sentences.zh: 他们找来数百名搬运工把它们运回去。

sentences.en: Of course, no wheels, no carts in Peru.
sentences.zh: 当然，秘鲁没有轮子，也没有马车。

sentences.en: God for llamas.
sentences.zh: 感谢上帝赐予骆马。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I mean, they have hundreds of porters carrying these things, literally like trudging across the mountains, carrying these great gold plates.
sentences.zh: 是啊，我的意思是，他们有数百名搬运工背着这些东西，简直就像是在山里艰难跋涉，背着这些巨大的金板。

sentences.en: They've got these pallets basically loaded with gold and silver.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是用托盘装满了金银。

sentences.en: And when they get back to Cajamarca, Pizarro and the people in Cajamarca just can't believe their eyes.
