sentences.zh: 显而易见的答案，最简单、最干净利落的做法，就是除掉他。

sentences.en: Kill him.
sentences.zh: 杀了他。

sentences.en: That's what Cortez and co.
sentences.zh: 这就是科尔特斯一伙人对蒙特祖马所做的事。

sentences.en: did with Montezuma.
sentences.zh: 我想科尔特斯一伙人就是这么做的。

sentences.en: I think that's what Cortez and co.
sentences.zh: 我想科尔特斯一伙人就是这么做的。

sentences.en: did.
sentences.zh: 唯一反驳这一点的是，如果他们只是想除掉他，如果所有关于鲁米尼亚维的事情都只是他们想做之事的借口，

sentences.en: The only thing that sort of cuts against that is, if they wanted to just get rid of him, and if all this stuff about Ruminjau is a pretext for doing what they always wanted to do,
sentences.zh: 为什么皮萨罗还在犹豫不决？

sentences.en: why does Pizarro hang around?
sentences.zh: 为什么有那么多关于他为此哭泣和内心挣扎的记载？

sentences.en: And why are there so many accounts of him crying and being conflicted about it all?
sentences.zh: 我们有一份记载。

sentences.en: We have one account.
sentences.zh: 他去见阿塔瓦尔帕并说，

sentences.en: He goes to see Atahualpa and he says,
sentences.zh: 我听说传言说你的人要来救你，你正通过结绳记事与他们沟通。

sentences.en: I've heard rumours that your men are going to come and rescue you and you're communicating with them through your knotted strings.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕嘲笑了他。

sentences.en: And Atahualpa scoffed at him.
sentences.zh: 你在开玩笑吗？

sentences.en: Are you joking?
sentences.zh: 面对像你们这样勇敢的人，我的人能有什么机会？

sentences.en: What chance would my men have against men as brave as you?
sentences.zh: 别再这样嘲弄我了。

sentences.en: Stop mocking me like this.
sentences.zh: 显然，一些西班牙人确实相信了他。

sentences.en: And clearly some of the Spaniards do believe him.
sentences.zh: 所以其中一个年轻人，一个叫佩德罗·卡塔尼奥的人，记得阿塔瓦尔帕识破了皮萨罗的虚张声势。

sentences.en: So one of the younger men, a guy called Pedro Catanio, remembers that Atahualpa called Pizarro's bluff.
sentences.zh: 如果真有战士从基多来，那也是奉我的命令。

sentences.en: If any warriors did come from Quito, they would be coming on my orders.
sentences.zh: 去查清楚是不是真的。

sentences.en: Find out whether it's true.
sentences.zh: 如果是真的，那就动手吧。

sentences.en: If it is true, then go ahead.
sentences.zh: 你可以处决我。

sentences.en: You can execute me.
sentences.zh: 西班牙方面的史料记载，皮萨罗觉得这让他压力很大。

sentences.en: And the Spanish sources say that Pizarro found this very stressful.
sentences.zh: 西班牙方面的史料记载，皮萨罗觉得这让他压力很大。

sentences.en: He couldn't decide what to do.
sentences.zh: 他无法决定该怎么做。

sentences.en: He ordered Atahualpa to be chained by the neck at this point to stop him escaping.
sentences.zh: 他下令将阿塔瓦尔帕的脖子锁住，以防他逃跑。

sentences.en: Is there not a kind of legal dimension to this?
sentences.zh: 这难道没有某种法律层面的考量吗？

sentences.en: Because we've talked throughout how legalistic the Spaniards are.
sentences.zh: 因为我们一直在谈论西班牙人是多么拘泥于法律条文。

sentences.en: His entire governorship depends on royal approval.
sentences.zh: 他的整个总督职位都取决于皇室的批准。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And killing an emperor who you've promised life to, I mean, it's not a good look, is it, from the perspective of the Spanish court?
sentences.zh: 而且杀掉一个你已经承诺保全性命的皇帝，我的意思是，从西班牙宫廷的角度来看，这可不是什么光彩的事，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, it may not just be kind of humanitarian instincts.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能不仅仅是出于某种人道主义本能。

sentences.en: It may be a genuine anxiety that he's torn between kind of legalistic imperatives and his sense of what would be practically the best thing to do, which would be to kill him.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一种真正的焦虑，他在法律上的必要性与他认为实际上最好的做法——即杀掉他——之间感到左右为难。

sentences.en: That's absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: I think, as we will see, he knows perfectly well that Charles V will go ballistic if he finds out that Pizarro has murdered a monarch.
sentences.zh: 我想，正如我们将要看到的，他非常清楚，如果查理五世发现皮萨罗谋杀了一位君主，一定会大发雷霆。

sentences.en: I mean, even in this Aztec story, Cortes had to make up a load of nonsense about Montezuma rebelling, having agreed to, in order to justify murdering Montezuma.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，即使在阿兹特克的故事里，科尔特斯为了证明谋杀蒙特祖马的合理性，也不得不编造了一大堆关于蒙特祖马叛乱的无稽之谈。

sentences.en: And I think this is exactly what Pizarro is facing right now.
sentences.zh: 我认为这正是皮萨罗现在所面临的情况。

sentences.en: Mid-July, 1533, he calls a big meeting to decide Atahualpa's fate, and all the big guns are there.
sentences.zh: 1533年7月中旬，他召开了一次大型会议来决定阿塔瓦尔帕的命运，所有重量级人物都出席了。

sentences.en: We're told that Pizarro and the men who had been there from the very beginning want to keep Atahualpa alive.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，皮萨罗和那些从一开始就在那里的人希望让阿塔瓦尔帕活下去。

sentences.en: They say it's honourable to keep him alive.
sentences.zh: 他们说留他一命才算体面。

sentences.en: They gave him their word because of the ransom.
sentences.zh: 因为赎金的事，他们给了他承诺。

sentences.en: The ransom's been paid.
sentences.zh: 赎金已经付清了。

sentences.en: We should keep our side of the bargain.
sentences.zh: 我们应该信守诺言。

sentences.en: They say he's a really useful hostage.
sentences.zh: 他们说他是一个非常有用的筹码。

sentences.en: Why would you give up a hostage like this?
sentences.zh: 为什么要放弃这样一个筹码呢？

sentences.en: They point out not a single Spaniard has been attacked or injured since they took him prisoner.
sentences.zh: 他们指出，自从把他关押起来后，没有一个西班牙人受到攻击或伤害。

sentences.en: You know, clearly this is working, so let's keep him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，显然这很有效，所以我们还是留着他吧。

sentences.en: And some of them actually clearly are fond of him.
sentences.zh: 而且他们中有些人显然确实很喜欢他。

sentences.en: You know, we know from the Chronicles and whatnot that there were people who spent their
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们从编年史之类的记载中得知，有些人花时间

sentences.en: evenings talking to him through the interpreters, you know, and actually said, he's not such a bad guy.
sentences.zh: 在晚上通过翻译与他交谈，你知道，他们实际上说，他并不是个坏人。

sentences.en: I don't think we should kill him.
sentences.zh: 我不认为我们应该杀了他。

sentences.en: But the people who've come with Alvarado take a very different view.
sentences.zh: 但那些随阿尔瓦拉多而来的人看法却大不相同。

sentences.en: They've got no investment in him.
sentences.zh: 他们在他身上没有任何投入。

sentences.en: They say he'll be a focus for resistance.
sentences.zh: 他们说他会成为反抗势力的核心。

sentences.en: You know, the longer this goes on, the more likely it is that his people will turn on us.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这件事拖得越久，他的人民反戈一击的可能性就越大。

sentences.en: And crucially, we want to go to Cusco to get our share of the gold.
sentences.zh: 而且至关重要的是，我们想去库斯科分得我们的那份黄金。

sentences.en: Can we please stop hanging around?
sentences.zh: 我们能不能别再磨蹭了？

sentences.en: Can we get rid?
sentences.zh: 我们能解决掉他吗？

sentences.en: The Spaniards can't agree.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人无法达成一致。

sentences.en: And Pizarro sends out a scouting party under Hernando de Soto to see if this northern army really is coming.
sentences.zh: 于是皮萨罗派出一支由埃尔南多·德·索托率领的侦察队，去看看那支北方军队是否真的在逼近。

sentences.en: And while de Soto is away, the tension mounts.
sentences.zh: 在德·索托离开期间，紧张局势加剧了。

sentences.en: It's cut to the chase.
sentences.zh: 长话短说。

sentences.en: There's an evening when they're playing cards.
sentences.zh: 有一天晚上，他们正在打牌。

sentences.en: And a Spaniard comes in and says, there's more rumors.
sentences.zh: 一个西班牙人走进来，说又有传言了。

sentences.en: There's people saying there are Inca troops approaching the town.
sentences.zh: 有人说印加军队正在向城镇逼近。

sentences.en: And Almagro and Pizarro have a huge row.
sentences.zh: 阿尔马格罗和皮萨罗大吵了一架。

sentences.en: And then a couple of evenings later, there is another such incident.
sentences.zh: 几天后的晚上，又发生了类似的事情。

sentences.en: Local people say they've seen the villagers outside fleeing before an Inca army.
sentences.zh: 当地人说他们看到城外的村民在印加军队面前逃跑。

sentences.en: The Inca army will be in Cajamarca in two days.
sentences.zh: 印加军队两天内就会到达卡哈马卡。

sentences.en: You know, the moment has come.
sentences.zh: 你知道，时刻到了。

sentences.en: Now, this army does not exiSt.
sentences.zh: 然而，这支军队根本不存在。

sentences.en: There is no attack on Cajamarca.
sentences.zh: 根本没有对卡哈马卡的攻击。

sentences.en: But as John Hemming says in his book, the key to the story is the hysteria and the paranoia that has now seized the Spaniards.
sentences.zh: 但正如约翰·赫明在他的书中所说，这个故事的关键在于现在笼罩在西班牙人心头的歇斯底里和偏执。

sentences.en: They're in the middle of nowhere.
sentences.zh: 他们身处荒郊野外。

sentences.en: They're thousands of miles from home.
sentences.zh: 他们离家数千里。

sentences.en: They're surrounded by 12 million people.
sentences.zh: 他们被1200万人包围着。

sentences.en: They're absolutely terrified now this gold is going to be taken from them, and they're going to be attacked.
sentences.zh: 他们现在极度恐惧，担心这些黄金会被夺走，担心自己会遭到攻击。

sentences.en: They've never fought an Inca army, actually.
sentences.zh: 事实上，他们从未与印加军队交战过。

sentences.en: They've attacked effectively unarmed Incas in the square.
sentences.zh: 他们之前是在广场上攻击了手无寸铁的印加人。

sentences.en: But that's not the same as a pitched battle where the Incas are attacking them.
sentences.zh: 但这与印加人主动进攻的正面战场是两码事。

sentences.en: I mean, I'd be paranoid in their shoes.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，换做是我，我也会变得偏执。

sentences.en: Of course you would.
sentences.zh: 你当然会。

sentences.en: Of course you would.
sentences.zh: 你当然会。

sentences.en: So they have another meeting.
sentences.zh: 于是他们又开了一次会。

sentences.en: Almagro and Co.
sentences.zh: 阿尔马格罗一伙

sentences.en: demand another meeting.
sentences.zh: 要求再开一次会。

sentences.en: And this time, it's clear that Pizarro is outnumbered.
sentences.zh: 这一次，很明显皮萨罗处于少数派。

sentences.en: And the royal officials, crucially, back Almagro up and say, yeah, Atualpa must die.
sentences.zh: 而皇室官员关键性地支持了阿尔马格罗，说，是的，阿塔瓦尔帕必须死。

sentences.en: And so Pizarro agrees.
sentences.zh: 于是皮萨罗同意了。

sentences.en: I don't doubt the sources that Pizarro is very reluctant, because they're kind of unanimous on this point.
sentences.zh: 我不怀疑那些认为皮萨罗非常不情愿的史料，因为他们在这一点上出奇地一致。

sentences.en: And he says, fine, quote, Atualpa must die since he had broken the peace and plotted treason in bringing men to kill the Christians.
sentences.zh: 他说，好吧，引用他的话，“阿塔瓦尔帕必须死，因为他破坏了和平，并密谋杀害基督徒”。

sentences.en: Now, the Spanish sources disagree on one thing, and actually historians themselves now disagree.
sentences.zh: 现在，西班牙史料在一点上存在分歧，实际上历史学家们现在也存在分歧。

sentences.en: Was there a trial or wasn't there?
sentences.zh: 到底有没有审判？

sentences.en: Because some said there was, some said there wasn't.
sentences.zh: 因为有些人说有，有些人说没有。

sentences.en: I think it's because the conquistadors are so legalistic.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是因为征服者们太拘泥于法律了。

sentences.en: They're always so anxious about being drawn into American-style lawsuits that they have some kind of rudimentary court-martial, because we do have accounts of it.
sentences.zh: 他们总是担心被卷入美式诉讼，所以他们搞了一种简易的军事法庭，因为我们确实有相关的记录。

sentences.en: I mean, some kind.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，某种形式的法庭。

sentences.en: So basically, a kangaroo court.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，就是一场袋鼠法庭。

sentences.en: Kangaroo court.
sentences.zh: 袋鼠法庭。

sentences.en: Pizarro and Almagro are the judges, and there's a prosecutor who's basically barking out questions at Atualpa.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗和阿尔马格罗是法官，还有一个检察官，基本上是在对阿塔瓦尔帕咆哮着提问。

sentences.en: Did you kill Huascar?
sentences.zh: 你杀了瓦斯卡尔吗？

sentences.en: Did you force your subjects to sacrifice women and children to your gods?
sentences.zh: 你是否强迫你的臣民向你们的神献祭妇女和儿童？

sentences.en: Were your wars just?
sentences.zh: 你的战争是正义的吗？

sentences.en: Have you been giving orders for the Spaniards to be killed?
sentences.zh: 你是否下令杀害西班牙人？

sentences.en: Some of the Spanish sources say the questions were ridiculous, and the interpreters were deliberately mangling the questions,
sentences.zh: 一些西班牙史料说这些问题很荒谬，翻译人员故意曲解了问题，

sentences.en: and Atualpa's answers to portray him in the worst possible light.
sentences.zh: 以及阿塔瓦尔帕的回答，以尽可能地抹黑他。

sentences.en: Atualpa, for all that we've said, he's a very hard man.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕，尽管我们说了那么多，他是个非常坚强的人。

sentences.en: He's also a very emotional man.
sentences.zh: 他也是一个感情丰富的人。

sentences.en: He breaks down in tears, and he says, I can give you twice as much gold and silver as I've already given you, if you'll spare me.
sentences.zh: 他泪流满面，说，如果你能饶我一命，我可以给你两倍于我已给你的黄金和白银。

sentences.en: And we're told that Pizarro was crying as well.
sentences.zh: 据说皮萨罗当时也哭了。

sentences.en: But Pizarro at the end says, you have been found guilty of idolatry, heresy, regicide, fratricide, treason, polygamy, and inceSt.
sentences.zh: 但皮萨罗最后说，你被判犯有偶像崇拜、异端邪说、弑君、弑亲、叛国、重婚和乱伦罪。

sentences.en: I mean, they really are throwing the book at him.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们真的是在罗织罪名。

sentences.en: And the sentence for all this is death, and because he had committed treason, he should die by burning unless he converted to Christianity.
sentences.zh: 所有这些罪名的判决都是死刑，而且因为他犯了叛国罪，他应该被火刑处死，除非他皈依基督教。

sentences.en: Now, this is very worrying for Atualpa because die by burning is unthinkable for an Inca.
sentences.zh: 这让阿塔瓦尔帕非常担心，因为对于印加人来说，火刑是不可想象的。

sentences.en: If he's going to live on in paradise, in Hanapancha, as the Incas call it, then his body cannot be burned, because you can't get into paradise if you've been burned.
sentences.zh: 如果他想在天堂——印加人称之为哈纳潘查——继续生活，那么他的身体就不能被焚烧，因为如果你被烧了，就进不了天堂。

sentences.en: And they mummify the bodies, don't they?
sentences.zh: 他们会把尸体制成木乃伊，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes, you must be embalmed.
sentences.zh: 是的，必须进行防腐处理。

sentences.en: If you're the emperor, and we will talk about this in the next episode, they will mummify you, and they'll give you your own palace in Cusco,
sentences.zh: 如果你是皇帝，我们会在下一集讨论这个问题，他们会把你制成木乃伊，并在库斯科给你一座属于你自己的宫殿，

sentences.en: and they'll bring you out at festivals.
sentences.zh: 而且他们会在节日里把你抬出来。

sentences.en: For royal weddings and things.
sentences.zh: 为了皇室婚礼之类的事情。

sentences.en: And parades and processions and things.
sentences.zh: 还有游行和庆典之类的活动。

sentences.en: You'll have your own servants and stuff when you're a mummy.
sentences.zh: 当你成为木乃伊时，你会有自己的仆人。

sentences.en: This is terrible if Atualpa can't enjoy this future joy.
sentences.zh: 如果阿塔瓦尔帕无法享受这种未来的快乐，那就太可怕了。

sentences.en: Now, he doesn't have much time to think about it.
sentences.zh: 现在，他没有太多时间去考虑这个问题了。

sentences.en: The trial ends, so-called trial, if there is a trial, ends in the early hours of Saturday the 26th of July.
sentences.zh: 审判，所谓的审判，如果算得上审判的话，在7月26日星期六的凌晨结束了。

sentences.en: And the Spaniards say, we want to get this done by tonight.
sentences.zh: 西班牙人说，我们想在今晚之前完成这件事。

sentences.en: Basically, A, in case Atualpa's rescued, or B, in case Pizarro changes his mind.
sentences.zh: 基本上，A，以防阿塔瓦尔帕被救走，或者B，以防皮萨罗改变主意。

sentences.en: And so that evening, nights falling,
sentences.zh: 于是那天晚上，夜幕降临，

sentences.en: Atualpa is led out into the square in Cajamarca, the place where he had been captured, before this big crowd, and he's tied to a stake.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕被带到卡哈马卡的广场上，也就是他被俘虏的地方，在众目睽睽之下，他被绑在木桩上。

sentences.en: It's an absolutely kind of heart-rending scene, even though he is a bad man in some ways.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是一个令人心碎的场景，尽管他在某些方面确实是个坏人。

sentences.en: He's sobbing like a baby.
sentences.zh: 他像个孩子一样啜泣。

sentences.en: He says, I want to entrust my children to Pizarro's protection.
sentences.zh: 他说，我想把我的孩子们托付给皮萨罗保护。

sentences.en: And Valverde, the Dominican friar, says to him, forget about your children, accept baptism, and die like a Christian.
sentences.zh: 多米尼加修士瓦尔韦德对他说，别管你的孩子了，接受洗礼，像个基督徒一样死去吧。

sentences.en: And we're told, Atualpa continued to persist in commending his sons with great weeping, indicating their size with his hand,
sentences.zh: 据记载，阿塔瓦尔帕继续痛哭流涕地托付他的儿子们，用手比划着他们的大小，

sentences.en: showing by the signs he made and by his words that they were small, and that he was leaving them in Quito.
sentences.zh: 通过他做的手势和说的话，表明他们还很小，而且他把他们留在了基多。

sentences.en: And eventually, Valverde says, well, you know,
sentences.zh: 最终，瓦尔韦德说，好吧，你知道，

sentences.en: Pizarro will look after them as though they're his own children.
sentences.zh: 皮萨罗会像照顾自己的孩子一样照顾他们的。

sentences.en: And Atualpa says, fine, in that case, I'll accept baptism and I'll become a Christian.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕说，好吧，既然这样，我接受洗礼，我愿意成为基督徒。

sentences.en: And the irony there is that he's doing that to preserve his, you know, his supernatural potency in the kingdom of the gods.
sentences.zh: 讽刺的是，他这样做是为了保全他在众神国度里的超自然力量。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So.
sentences.zh: 所以。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: Valverde then baptizes him, and he gives him the name Francisco, of all names.
sentences.zh: 瓦尔韦德随后为他施洗，并给了他一个名字，弗朗西斯科，竟然是这个名字。

sentences.en: And then, he's not going to be burned.
sentences.zh: 然后，他不会被火烧了。

sentences.en: The guards tie a cord around Atualpa's neck.
sentences.zh: 守卫在阿塔瓦尔帕的脖子上系了一根绳子。

sentences.en: And as Valverde leads the Spaniards in reciting the creed, Atualpa is garrotted.
sentences.zh: 当瓦尔韦德带领西班牙人诵读信经时，阿塔瓦尔帕被绞死了。

sentences.en: So that is the end of him.
sentences.zh: 这就是他的结局。

sentences.en: But a couple more details.
sentences.zh: 但还有几个细节。

sentences.en: First of all, the Spanish, of course, had promised him he would not be burned.
sentences.zh: 首先，西班牙人当然承诺过他不会被火烧。

sentences.en: Now, they don't burn him to ashes.
sentences.zh: 现在，他们没有把他烧成灰烬。

sentences.en: They grill him.
sentences.zh: 他们烤了他。

sentences.en: They give him a grilling, and then they leave his grilled body in the square overnight, quote, for everyone to learn of his death.
sentences.zh: 他们对他进行了烧烤，然后把烤过的尸体留在广场上过夜，引用的话说，“让所有人都知道他的死讯”。

sentences.en: It's basically a message.
sentences.zh: 这基本上是一个信号。

sentences.en: And that grilling, I think, is a gesture.
sentences.zh: 我认为那种烧烤是一种姿态。

sentences.en: You know, you and I talked about this before we started recording.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们在录音前谈过这件事。

sentences.en: I think this is a gesture of contempt for him, probably by the Almagreistas.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是对他的一种蔑视，很可能是阿尔马格罗派的人干的。

sentences.en: So he's buried, isn't he, in the local church?
sentences.zh: 所以他被埋在当地的教堂里了，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But there are stories that people rescue the body, take it to Ecuador, up to Quito, and mummify it.
sentences.zh: 但有传言说有人救走了尸体，把它带到了厄瓜多尔，带到了基多，并把它制成了木乃伊。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And there are kind of archaeologists who go on a-
sentences.zh: 还有一些考古学家去进行——

sentences.en: Indiana Jones type, yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 印第安纳·琼斯那种，没错，正是如此。

sentences.en: Maybe out there, Atualpa's mummified body.
sentences.zh: 也许阿塔瓦尔帕的木乃伊就在那里。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Lightly grilled is still there.
sentences.zh: 被轻微烤过的尸体还在那里。

sentences.en: Who knows?
sentences.zh: 谁知道呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's perfectly possible.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这完全有可能。

sentences.en: There is, not, I think, straight away, but I think in subsequent decades, there starts to be this kind of cult of Atualpa, and a belief that maybe he might come back from the dead.
sentences.zh: 我认为不是马上，但在随后的几十年里，开始出现了一种阿塔瓦尔帕崇拜，人们相信他可能会死而复生。

sentences.en: Pedro Pizarro records a very weird scene.
sentences.zh: 佩德罗·皮萨罗记录了一个非常奇怪的场景。

sentences.en: Basically, two of Atualpa's sisters got into Pizarro's apartment, and, quote, began to call for Atualpa, searching very softly for him in all the corners.
sentences.zh: 基本上，阿塔瓦尔帕的两个姐妹进入了皮萨罗的公寓，引用的话说，“开始呼唤阿塔瓦尔帕，在所有角落里轻声寻找他”。

sentences.en: But seeing that he did not answer, they went out making a great lamentation.
sentences.zh: 但看到他没有回应，她们便发出巨大的哀号离开了。

sentences.en: I disabused them and told them that dead men do not return.
sentences.zh: 我劝解了她们，告诉她们死人是不会回来的。

sentences.en: The really interesting thing, though, is the reaction of the Spanish themselves.
sentences.zh: 然而，真正有趣的是西班牙人自己的反应。

sentences.en: Remember, I said that they'd sent off Hernando de Soto to look for this northern army.
sentences.zh: 还记得吗，我说过他们派埃尔南多·德·索托去寻找那支北方军队。

sentences.en: Soto gets back, and he says, there's no northern army.
sentences.zh: 索托回来了，他说，根本没有北方军队。

sentences.en: I mean, it's been made up.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那是编造出来的。

sentences.en: There's no Inca troops advancing on the town.
sentences.zh: 根本没有印加军队在向城镇推进。

sentences.en: And then he discovers they've killed Atualpa, and he goes, absolutely ballistic.
sentences.zh: 然后他发现他们杀了阿塔瓦尔帕，他简直气疯了。

sentences.en: And he says, how could you do this behind my back when I was gone?
sentences.zh: 他说，我不在的时候，你们怎么能背着我做这种事？

sentences.en: I'm meant to be the number two man in this expedition.
sentences.zh: 我可是这次远征的二号人物。

sentences.en: You've killed this guy who was our chief hostage and one of our biggest assets.
sentences.zh: 你们杀掉了这个我们最重要的筹码，也是我们最大的资产之一。

sentences.en: Now, meanwhile, Pizarro, one of his secretaries, writes a report for him to Charles V, saying,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，皮萨罗的一位秘书为他写了一份给查理五世的报告，上面写着：

sentences.en: I have executed a monarch, but I'm just going to explain exactly why I've done it.
sentences.zh: 我处决了一位君主，但我会解释清楚我为什么要这么做。

sentences.en: And the reaction in Spain was that Pizarro had behaved badly.
sentences.zh: 而西班牙国内的反应是，皮萨罗的行为非常恶劣。

sentences.en: Not that Pizarro had done the right thing, but that Pizarro had let Spain down.
sentences.zh: 并不是说皮萨罗做对了，而是说皮萨罗让西班牙蒙羞了。

sentences.en: So there's a judge in Panama called Gaspard Espinosa, who's writing all the time to Charles V, basically sending him reports of what these guys are getting up to in Peru.
sentences.zh: 所以巴拿马有一位名叫加斯帕尔·埃斯皮诺萨的法官，他一直在给查理五世写信，基本上是向他汇报这些人在这群人在秘鲁的所作所为。

sentences.en: And he writes to Charles V, and he says, the Spanish in Cajamarca are totally out of control.
sentences.zh: 他写信给查理五世说，卡哈马卡的西班牙人已经完全失控了。

sentences.en: Their greed is so great as to be insatiable.
sentences.zh: 他们的贪婪简直到了无法满足的地步。

sentences.en: The more the native chiefs give, the more the Spaniards kill or torture them to give even more.
sentences.zh: 当地酋长给的越多，西班牙人就越是杀戮或折磨他们，逼他们交出更多。

sentences.en: He says, they should never have killed Atualpa, a man who'd fallen into their hands and who'd done no harm to any Spaniard.
sentences.zh: 他说，他们根本不该杀掉阿塔瓦尔帕，一个落入他们手中且从未伤害过任何西班牙人的人。

sentences.en: They could have sent him here to Panama with his wives and servants as his rank deserved.
sentences.zh: 他们本可以按照他的身份，把他和他的妻妾仆从一起送到巴拿马来。

sentences.en: We would all have honoured him and treated him like a great noble of Castile.
sentences.zh: 我们都会尊重他，像对待卡斯蒂利亚的大贵族一样对待他。

sentences.en: And actually, this becomes this established, this will surprise some listeners who just think of this,
sentences.zh: 事实上，这已经成为了一种定论，这会让一些听众感到惊讶，因为他们只想到这一点，

sentences.en: you know, who have subscribed to the black legend of Spain, of 16th century Spain, as uniquely cruel and, you know, greedy and whatnot.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那些认同关于西班牙，关于16世纪西班牙的“黑色传说”的人，认为他们极其残忍、贪婪等等。

sentences.en: Most Spanish chroniclers agreed that Pizarro had done the wrong thing.
sentences.zh: 大多数西班牙编年史家都认为皮萨罗做错了。

sentences.en: So this is Gonzalo Fernández de Oviedo in the 1530s.
sentences.zh: 这是16世纪30年代的贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·奥维耶多。
zh_words: 贡萨洛·费尔南德斯·德·奥维耶

sentences.en: The killing of so great a prince was an infamous disservice to God and the emperor, an act of great ingratitude and outstanding evil.
sentences.zh: 杀害这样一位伟大的君主是对上帝和皇帝的无耻背叛，是一种极度忘恩负义和极其邪恶的行为。

sentences.en: And this is probably most influential of all the Spanish writers about Peru,
sentences.zh: 而这可能是所有关于秘鲁的西班牙作家中最具影响力的一位，

sentences.en: Pedro Theata de Leon in the 1550s.
sentences.zh: 16世纪50年代的佩德罗·西耶萨·德·莱昂。

sentences.en: The most evil deed the Spaniards have done in all the Empire of the Indies.
sentences.zh: 这是西班牙人在整个印第安帝国所做的最邪恶的勾当。

sentences.en: It is widely vituperated and it's considered a grave sin.
sentences.zh: 它受到了广泛的谴责，被认为是一种严重的罪孽。

sentences.en: And this is definitely what the king himself thought, Charles V, because when he wrote back
sentences.zh: 这绝对也是国王查理五世本人的想法，因为当他回信

sentences.en: to Pizarro, he said, we have been displeased by the death of Atahualpa since he was a monarch.
sentences.zh: 给皮萨罗时，他说，阿塔瓦尔帕的死让我们感到不悦，因为他毕竟是一位君主。

sentences.en: And particularly as it was done in the name of justice, we will seek more information about this matter and then order what is necessary.
sentences.zh: 尤其是这还是以正义的名义进行的，我们将寻求关于此事的更多信息，然后下达必要的指令。

sentences.en: And if you're Pizarro reading this, you surely think, oh no.
sentences.zh: 如果你是皮萨罗，读到这些，你肯定会想，噢，不。

sentences.en: And that's probably what Pizarro was worrying about.
sentences.zh: 这很可能就是皮萨罗所担心的。

sentences.en: Exactly that reaction.
sentences.zh: 正是这种反应。

sentences.en: Atahualpa is dead and Pizarro's position is looking a little bit rickety.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕死了，皮萨罗的地位看起来有点摇摇欲坠。

sentences.en: So his brother Hernando, on whom he relied, has gone back to Spain with some of the gold.
sentences.zh: 他所依赖的兄弟埃尔南多带着一些黄金回到了西班牙。

sentences.en: His chief lieutenant, Hernando de Soto, is furious with him about the death of Atahualpa.
sentences.zh: 他的首席副官埃尔南多·德·索托对他杀害阿塔瓦尔帕的行为感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And his partner, Diego de Almagro, is absolutely furious.
sentences.zh: 而他的合伙人迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗更是怒不可遏。

sentences.en: Yeah, he's livid.
sentences.zh: 没错，他气炸了。

sentences.en: Yeah, livid.
sentences.zh: 是的，气炸了。

sentences.en: He is livid about the unequal division of the treasure.
sentences.zh: 他因为宝藏分配不均而感到愤怒。

sentences.en: And now, Pizarro and his men are facing their biggest challenge yet.
sentences.zh: 现在，皮萨罗和他的手下正面临着迄今为止最大的挑战。

sentences.en: Atahualpa is dead and the Inca empire is leaderless.
sentences.zh: 阿塔瓦尔帕已死，印加帝国群龙无首。

sentences.en: So they need to find a new puppet on whom they can rely.
sentences.zh: 所以他们需要找到一个新的傀儡来依靠。

sentences.en: And Tom, their road now lies south, up into the Andes, across the Inca heartland, to the city of gold, Cusco.
sentences.zh: 汤姆，他们现在的路向南延伸，进入安第斯山脉，穿过印加的心脏地带，直达黄金之城——库斯科。

sentences.en: But what awaits them there is darker and bloodier and more dramatic than even they could possibly have imagined.
sentences.zh: 但在那里等待他们的，比他们所能想象的还要黑暗、血腥和戏剧性。

sentences.en: Well, dear listeners, if you like darkness and blood-stained drama, then wow, we've got a treat for you in the next episode.
sentences.zh: 好了，亲爱的听众们，如果你喜欢黑暗和血腥的戏剧，那么哇，我们在下一集中为你准备了一份大礼。

sentences.en: Members of the Restless History Club, of course, can hear it right away, together with the final two episodes in this series.
sentences.zh: 当然，“不安分历史俱乐部”的成员可以立即收听，以及本系列的最后两集。

sentences.en: And if you're not a member of the Restless History Club, then you can join them by going to therestlesshistory.com to sign up.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是“不安分历史俱乐部”的成员，你可以访问therestlesshistory.com注册加入他们。

sentences.en: But for now, hasta luego.
sentences.zh: 但现在，再见。

sentences.en: Bye-bye.
sentences.zh: 拜拜。
